statement: RFO FAR 15.103-2(c) says its limitations on the LPTA approach apply except for DoD, in accordance with section 880 of the act it cites.
quote: (c) Limitations. Except for DoD, in accordance with section 880 of the
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (c), with must in place of shall.

statement: RFO FAR 15.103-2(c)(1)(i) lists, as a condition for using the approach, that the agency can comprehensively and clearly describe the minimum requirements in terms of performance objectives, measures, and standards that will be used to determine the acceptability of offers.
quote: (i) The agency can comprehensively and clearly describe the minimum requirements in terms of performance objectives, measures, and standards that will be used to determine the acceptability of offers;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The condition is the same as the codified paragraph (c)(1).

statement: RFO FAR 15.103-2(c)(1)(ii) lists, as a condition for using the approach, that the agency would realize no, or minimal, value from a proposal that exceeds the minimum technical or performance requirements.
quote: (ii) The agency would realize no, or minimal, value from a proposal that exceeds the minimum technical or performance requirements;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The condition is the same as the codified paragraph (c)(2).

statement: RFO FAR 15.103-2(c)(1)(iii) lists, as a condition for using the approach, that the agency believes the technical proposals will require no, or minimal, subjective judgment by the source selection authority as to the desirability of one offeror's proposal versus a competing proposal.
quote: (iii) The agency believes the technical proposals will require no, or minimal, subjective judgment by the source selection authority as to the desirability of one offeror's proposal versus a competing proposal;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The condition is the same as the codified paragraph (c)(3).

statement: RFO FAR 15.103-2(c)(1)(iv) lists, as a condition for using the approach, that the agency has a high degree of confidence that reviewing the technical proposals of all offerors would not result in the identification of characteristics that could provide value or benefit to the agency.
quote: (iv) The agency has a high degree of confidence that reviewing the technical proposals of all offerors would not result in the identification of characteristics that could provide value or benefit to the agency;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The condition is the same as the codified paragraph (c)(4).

statement: RFO FAR 15.103-2(c)(1)(v) lists, as a condition for using the approach, that the agency determined that the lowest price reflects the total cost, including operation and support, of the products or services being acquired; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-EST-3309.
quote: (v) The agency determined that the lowest price reflects the total cost, including operation and support, of the product(s) or service(s) being acquired; and
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The condition is the same as the codified paragraph (c)(5).

statement: RFO FAR 15.103-2(c)(1)(vi) lists, as a condition for using the approach, that the contracting officer documents the contract file describing the circumstances that justify the use of the LPTA source selection process.
quote: (vi) The contracting officer documents the contract file describing the circumstances that justify the use of the LPTA source selection process.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The condition is the same as the codified paragraph (c)(6).

statement: RFO FAR 15.202(b)(1) says that, when using the LPTA approach, proposals are evaluated for technical acceptability only.
quote: When using the lowest price technically acceptable (LPTA) approach, proposals are evaluated for technical acceptability only.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph says proposals are evaluated for acceptability but not ranked using the non-cost/price factors; this RFO sentence says they are evaluated for technical acceptability only.

statement: RFO FAR 15.202(c)(2) says that, if past performance is evaluated when using the LPTA source selection process, contracting officers must only determine if the performance is technically acceptable and not perform a comparative assessment of the information.
quote: If past performance is evaluated when using the LPTA source selection process, contracting officers must only determine if the performance is technically acceptable and not perform a comparative assessment of the information.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph says past performance need not be an evaluation factor if the contracting officer documents the file, and that if it is considered the comparative assessment does not apply; this RFO sentence is written for the case where past performance is evaluated and says only acceptability is determined.

statement: RFO FAR 15.001 defines a deficiency as any part of an offer that does not conform to a material requirement of a RFP, and a material requirement as one that affects price, quantity, quality, or delivery, or that the RFP requires to be met at the time of proposal submission.
quote: Deficiency is any part of an offer that does not conform to a material requirement of a RFP. A material requirement is one that affects price, quantity, quality, or delivery, or that the RFP requires to be met at the time of proposal submission.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified definition is a material failure of a proposal to meet a Government requirement or a combination of significant weaknesses that raises the risk of unsuccessful contract performance to an unacceptable level; this RFO definition is any part of an offer that does not conform to a material requirement of a RFP.

statement: RFO FAR 15.001 defines a proposal modification as a change made to a proposal before the RFP closing date and time, or made in response to an amendment, or made to correct a mistake at any time before award.
quote: Proposal modification is a change made to a proposal before the RFP closing date and time, or made in response to an amendment, or made to correct a mistake at any time before award.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The definition is the same in substance as the codified one, with RFP closing date and time in place of solicitation closing date and time.

statement: RFO FAR 15.001 defines a proposal revision as a change to material elements of a proposal made after the RFP closing date, at the request of or as allowed by a contracting officer, as the result of negotiations.
quote: Proposal revision is a change to material elements of a proposal made after the RFP closing date, at the request of or as allowed by a contracting officer, as the result of negotiations.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified definition says a change to a proposal made after the solicitation closing date; this RFO definition says a change to material elements of a proposal made after the RFP closing date.

statement: RFO FAR 15.001 defines a weakness as a flaw in the proposal that increases the risk of unsuccessful contract performance, and a significant weakness as a flaw that appreciably increases that risk.
quote: Weakness means a flaw in the proposal that increases the risk of unsuccessful contract performance. A “significant weakness” in the proposal is a flaw that appreciably increases the risk of unsuccessful contract performance.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The definitions are the same as the codified ones.

statement: RFO FAR 15.002(a) says that, when an award is made to a single vendor without soliciting offers from multiple sources, agencies should remove unnecessary information and requirements from the request for proposal, including voluminous proposal preparation instructions and evaluation factors.
quote: single vendor without soliciting offers from multiple sources. When using this acquisition strategy, agencies should remove unnecessary information and requirements from the request for proposal (RFP), including voluminous proposal preparation instructions and evaluation factors.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (a), which also says should; the RFO paragraph adds a definition of noncompetitive acquisition in its first sentence and says including where the codified text says e.g.

statement: RFO FAR 15.002(b) says that, in a competitive acquisition, which is a process whereby an award is made after soliciting offers from multiple sources, agencies should tailor the complexity of the RFP, evaluation, and source selection decision to the circumstances of the acquisition; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-EST-3318.
quote: Competitive acquisition is a process whereby an award is made after soliciting offers from multiple sources. When using this acquisition strategy, agencies should tailor the complexity of the RFP, evaluation, and source selection decision to the circumstances of the acquisition
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph says the procedures of this part are intended to minimize the complexity of the solicitation, the evaluation, and the source selection decision; this RFO paragraph says agencies should tailor that complexity to the circumstances of the acquisition.

statement: RFO FAR 15.002(b) adds that this is done while maintaining a process that promotes an impartial and comprehensive evaluation of proposals, leading to selection of the proposal representing the best value to the Government.
quote: while maintaining a process that promotes an impartial and comprehensive evaluation of proposals, leading to selection of the proposal representing the best value to the Government.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same in substance as the second half of the codified paragraph (b).

statement: RFO FAR 15.103 says agencies can obtain best value in competitive negotiated acquisitions by using any one or a combination of source selection approaches, including but not limited to the approaches mentioned in that section.
quote: Agencies can obtain best value in competitive negotiated acquisitions by using any one or a combination of source selection approaches, including but not limited to the approaches mentioned in this section.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified section says an agency can obtain best value in negotiated acquisitions by using any one or a combination of source selection approaches; the RFO sentence is limited to competitive negotiated acquisitions and adds including but not limited to the approaches mentioned in the section.

statement: RFO FAR 15.103 says that, to obtain best value, agencies use a range of approaches for evaluating competitive offers, where the importance of cost or price varies relative to other factors such as technical merit and past performance.
quote: To obtain best value, agencies use a range of approaches for evaluating competitive offers, where the importance of cost or price varies relative to other factors such as technical merit and past performance.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified section gives examples in which cost or price may play a dominant role and in which technical or past performance considerations may; this RFO sentence states in general terms that the importance of cost or price varies relative to other factors.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-1(a) says contracting officers must notify offerors promptly in writing when their proposals are excluded from the competitive range or otherwise eliminated from the competition, and that the notice must state the basis for the determination and that proposal revisions will not be considered.
quote: Contracting officers must notify offerors promptly in writing when their proposals are excluded from the competitive range or otherwise eliminated from the competition. The notice must state the basis for the determination and that proposal revisions will not be considered.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (a)(1), with must in place of shall.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-1(b)(1) says that, when using a set-aside for small business, HUBZone, the Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Program, or the Women-Owned Small Business Program, contracting officers must notify each offeror, in writing, prior to award and upon completion of negotiations and determinations of responsibility; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-EST-3323.
quote: When using a set-aside for small business, HUBZone, the Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Program, or the Women-Owned Small Business Program, contracting officers must notify each offeror, in writing, prior to award and upon completion of negotiations and determinations of responsibility
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph lists a small business set-aside and the procedures for the HUBZone, service-disabled veteran-owned small business and Women-Owned Small Business programs by section number; this RFO paragraph names a set-aside for small business, HUBZone, the Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Program, or the Women-Owned Small Business Program.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-1(b)(1)(i)-(ii) lists two contents for the small business set-aside notice: the name and address of the apparently successful offeror, and that the Government will not consider subsequent revisions of the offeror's proposal.
quote: (i) Of the name and address of the apparently successful offeror; and (ii) That the Government will not consider subsequent revisions of the offeror's proposal.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph lists a third content, that no response is required unless a basis exists to challenge the size status or small business status of the apparently successful offeror; the RFO paragraph lists two contents, joined by and.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-1(b)(2)-(3) says the small business set-aside notice is in addition to any notice of exclusion from competitive range, and is not required when the contracting officer determines in writing that the urgency of the requirement necessitates award without delay or when the contract is entered into under the 8(a) program.
quote: (2) This notice is in addition to any notice of exclusion from competitive range. (3) This notice is not required when the contracting officer determines in writing that the urgency of the requirement necessitates award without delay or when the contract is entered into under the 8(a) program.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The two rules are the same in substance as the codified paragraphs (a)(2)(i) and (a)(2)(iii), without the codified cross-reference to 19.805-2.

statement: RFO FAR 15.207-2(b) says that, within 3 days after the date of contract award, contracting officers must provide written notification to each offeror whose proposal was in the competitive range but was not selected for award or had not previously received a notice in accordance with 15.206-1(a).
quote: Within 3 days after the date of contract award, contracting officers must provide written notification to each offeror whose proposal was in the competitive range but was not selected for award (10 U.S.C. 3304 and 41 U.S.C. 3704) or had not previously received a notice in accordance with 15.206-1(a)
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (b)(1), with the earlier notice now cited as 15.206-1(a).

statement: RFO FAR 15.207-2(b)(1)-(3) says the notice must include the number of offerors solicited, the number of proposals received, and the name and address of each offeror receiving an award.
quote: The notice must include— (1) The number of offerors solicited; (2) The number of proposals received; (3) The name and address of each offeror receiving an award;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The list is the same as the codified paragraphs (b)(1)(i) to (iii).

statement: RFO FAR 15.207-2(b)(4) says that, if the number of items or other factors makes listing any stated unit prices impracticable at that time, only the total contract price need be furnished in the notice, and that the items, quantities, and any stated unit prices of each award must be made publicly available, upon request; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-EST-3328.
quote: (i) If the number of items or other factors makes listing any stated unit prices impracticable at that time, only the total contract price need be furnished in the notice. (ii) The items, quantities, and any stated unit prices of each award must be made publicly available, upon request; and
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (b)(1)(iv), which joins the public availability sentence with However.

statement: RFO FAR 15.207-2(b)(5) says the notice must include, in general terms, the reason the offeror's proposal was not accepted, unless the price information in paragraph (b)(4) readily reveals the reason.
quote: (5) In general terms, the reason(s) the offeror's proposal was not accepted, unless the price information in paragraph (b)(4) of this section readily reveals the reason.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (b)(1)(v).

statement: RFO FAR 15.207-2(b)(5) says an offeror's cost breakdown, profit, overhead rates, trade secrets, manufacturing processes and techniques, or other confidential business information must not be disclosed to any other offeror.
quote: An offeror's cost breakdown, profit, overhead rates, trade secrets, manufacturing processes and techniques, or other confidential business information must not be disclosed to any other offeror.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same in substance as the last sentence of the codified paragraph (b)(1), with must not in place of in no event shall.

statement: RFO FAR 15.207-2(c) says that, upon request, contracting officers must provide the information in paragraph (b) to unsuccessful offerors that received a preaward notice of exclusion from the competitive range.
quote: Upon request, contracting officers must provide the information in paragraph (b) of this section to unsuccessful offerors that received a preaward notice of exclusion from the competitive range.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph (b)(3) is the same in substance, and the codified paragraph (b)(2) adds unsuccessful offerors in solicitations using simplified acquisition procedures in part 13; this RFO paragraph is a single sentence that names the offerors that received a preaward notice of exclusion.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(a)(1) says offerors may request a postaward debriefing by submitting a written request for the debriefing to the contracting officer within 3 days after receipt of the award notice in accordance with 15.207-2, and that such offerors must be debriefed and furnished the basis for the selection decision and contract award.
quote: Offerors may request a postaward debriefing by submitting a written request for the debriefing to the contracting officer within 3 days after receipt of the award notice in accordance with 15.207-2. Such offerors must be debriefed and furnished the basis for the selection decision and contract award
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph speaks of a written request received by the agency within 3 days after the offeror received notification of contract award; this RFO paragraph speaks of submitting a written request to the contracting officer within 3 days after receipt of the award notice.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(a)(2) says that, to the maximum extent practicable, the debriefing should occur within 5 days after receipt of the written request.
quote: To the maximum extent practicable, the debriefing should occur within 5 days after receipt of the written request.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same as the first sentence of the codified paragraph (a)(2).

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(a)(3)-(4) says untimely debriefing requests may be accommodated, and that an offeror notified of its exclusion from the competitive range is not entitled to a postaward debriefing if it failed to submit a timely preaward debriefing request, however such a request may be accommodated.
quote: (3) Untimely debriefing requests may be accommodated. (4) An offeror that was notified of its exclusion from the competitive range is not entitled to a postaward debriefing if the offeror failed to submit a timely preaward debriefing request, however such a request may be accommodated.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph (a)(3) says an offeror notified of exclusion from the competition that failed to submit a timely request is not entitled to a debriefing; this RFO paragraph speaks of exclusion from the competitive range and a timely preaward debriefing request, and adds that such a request may be accommodated.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(c)(1) says the debriefing information must include, at a minimum, among its listed items, the Government's evaluation of the significant weaknesses or deficiencies in the offeror's proposal, if applicable.
quote: At a minimum, the debriefing information must include— (i) The Government's evaluation of the significant weaknesses or deficiencies in the offeror's proposal, if applicable;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (d)(1), with must in place of shall.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(c)(1)(ii) lists the overall evaluated cost or price and technical rating of the successful offeror and the debriefed offeror, and past performance information on the debriefed offeror.
quote: (ii) The overall evaluated cost or price and technical rating of the successful offeror and the debriefed offeror, and past performance information on the debriefed offeror;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified item reads overall evaluated cost or price (including unit prices) and technical rating, if applicable; this RFO item has neither the including unit prices words nor the if applicable words.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(c)(1)(iii)-(v) lists the overall ranking of all offerors, when any ranking was developed by the agency during the source selection, a summary of the rationale for award, and, for acquisitions of commercial products, the make and model of the product to be delivered by the successful offeror.
quote: (iii) The overall ranking of all offerors, when any ranking was developed by the agency during the source selection; (iv) A summary of the rationale for award; (v) For acquisitions of commercial products, the make and model of the product to be delivered by the successful offeror;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The items are the same as the codified paragraphs (d)(3) to (d)(5).

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(c)(1)(vi) lists reasonable responses to relevant questions about whether source selection procedures contained in the request for proposals (RFP), applicable regulations, and other applicable authorities were followed by the agency.
quote: (vi) Reasonable responses to relevant questions about whether source selection procedures contained in the request for proposals (RFP), applicable regulations, and other applicable authorities were followed by the agency;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The item is the same in substance as the codified paragraph (d)(6), with request for proposals in place of solicitation.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(c)(1)(vii) lists, for DoD contracts in excess of $10 million but not in excess of $100 million with a small business or nontraditional defense contractor, an option for the contractor to request disclosure of the agency's written source selection decision document; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-EST-3339.
quote: For DoD contracts in excess of $10 million but not in excess of $100 million with a small business or nontraditional defense contractor (10 U.S.C. 3014), an option for the contractor to request disclosure of the agency's written source selection decision document
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph (d) lists six minimum items and this DoD item is an additional item in the RFO paragraph.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(c)(1)(vii) says the disclosure the contractor may request is of the agency's written source selection decision document, redacted to protect the confidential and proprietary information of other offerors for the contract award.
quote: an option for the contractor to request disclosure of the agency's written source selection decision document, redacted to protect the confidential and proprietary information of other offerors for the contract award.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph (d) lists six minimum items and this DoD item is an additional item in the RFO paragraph.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(c)(1)(viii) lists, for award of a DoD contract in excess of $100 million, disclosure of the agency's written source selection decision document, redacted to protect the information of other offerors for the contract award, in accordance with paragraph (d) of that subsection.
quote: (viii) For award of a DoD contract in excess of $100 million, disclosure of the agency's written source selection decision document, redacted to protect the information of other offerors for the contract award, in accordance with paragraph (d) of this subsection.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph (d) lists six minimum items and this DoD item is an additional item in the RFO paragraph.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(d) says the debriefing must not include point-by-point comparisons of the debriefed offeror's proposal with those of other offerors.
quote: The debriefing must not include point-by-point comparisons of the debriefed offeror's proposal with those of other offerors.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same in substance as the first sentence of the codified paragraph (e), with must not in place of shall not.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(d) says the debriefing must not reveal any information prohibited from disclosure by part 24 or exempt from release under the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. 552), including trade secrets and privileged or confidential manufacturing processes and techniques.
quote: Moreover, the debriefing must not reveal any information prohibited from disclosure by part 24 or exempt from release under the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. 552) including— (1) Trade secrets; (2) Privileged or confidential manufacturing processes and techniques;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The codified paragraph cites information prohibited from disclosure by 24.202; this RFO paragraph cites information prohibited from disclosure by part 24.

statement: RFO FAR 15.301-1(d)(3)-(4) lists commercial and financial information that is privileged or confidential, including cost breakdowns, profit, indirect cost rates, and similar information, and the names of individuals providing reference information about an offeror's past performance, among the information the debriefing must not reveal.
quote: (3) Commercial and financial information that is privileged or confidential, including cost breakdowns, profit, indirect cost rates, and similar information; and (4) The names of individuals providing reference information about an offeror's past performance.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The two items are the same as the codified paragraphs (e)(3) and (e)(4).

statement: RFO FAR 15.202(a)(2)(iii) adds, after its bar on using clarifications to revise a proposal, that contracting officers may request additional information or documentation provided the cost/price or other material elements of the proposal are unchanged.
quote: However, contracting officers may request additional information or documentation provided the cost/price or other material elements of the proposal are unchanged.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The sentence follows the clarification limit carried by CL-EST-3264. The codified communications paragraph at 15.306(b)(2) has no sentence that allows a request for additional information or documentation on this condition.

statement: RFO FAR 15.202(a)(2)(ii) lists, in its list of matters that clarifications include, the relevance of an offeror's past performance information and adverse past performance information to which the offeror has not previously had an opportunity to respond.
quote: the relevance of an offeror's past performance information; and adverse past performance information to which the offeror has not previously had an opportunity to respond.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The lead-in to the list is carried by CL-EST-3587. The codified paragraph (a)(2) gives the relevance of past performance information and adverse past performance information as examples of what offerors may be allowed to clarify when award is made without discussions, and the codified discussion minimum in (d)(3) lists adverse past performance information. This RFO item places adverse past performance information among the matters clarifications include, and the RFO negotiation minimum quoted in CL-EST-3270 does not list it.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2 says offerors excluded from the competitive range or otherwise excluded from the competition before award may request a debriefing before award.
quote: Offerors excluded from the competitive range or otherwise excluded from the competition before award may request a debriefing before award (10 U.S.C. 3305 and 41 U.S.C. 3705).
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO section opens with the same sentence as codified FAR 15.505. The RFO opening then carries the chairing and support sentences that codified FAR 15.505(d) has: the RFO text says the contracting officer should chair any debriefing held where the codified text says should normally chair, and says individuals who conducted evaluations must provide support where the codified text says shall.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(a)(1) says offerors may request a preaward debriefing by submitting a written request for debriefing to the contracting officer within 3 days after receipt of the notice of exclusion from the competition.
quote: (1) Offerors may request a preaward debriefing by submitting a written request for debriefing to the contracting officer within 3 days after receipt of the notice of exclusion from the competition.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO paragraph says "Offerors" where the codified paragraph says "The offeror"; the written request and the 3-day period are the same.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(a)(2) says that at the offeror's request the preaward debriefing may be delayed until after award, and that a debriefing delayed until after award must include all information normally provided in a postaward debriefing.
quote: (2) At the offeror's request, this debriefing may be delayed until after award. If the debriefing is delayed until after award, it must include all information normally provided in a postaward debriefing.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO sentence uses "must" for "shall" and does not carry the codified cross-reference to 15.506(d).

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(a)(3) says that if the offeror does not submit a timely request it need not be given either a preaward or a postaward debriefing, and that offerors are entitled to no more than one debriefing for each proposal.
quote: (3) If the offeror does not submit a timely request, the offeror need not be given either a preaward or a postaward debriefing. Offerors are entitled to no more than one debriefing for each proposal.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same as the codified paragraph.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(c)(1)(i) and (ii) say that at a minimum preaward debriefings must include the agency's evaluation of significant elements in the offeror's proposal and a summary of the rationale for eliminating the offeror from the competition; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-EST-3351.
quote: (1) At a minimum, preaward debriefings must include— (i) The agency's evaluation of significant elements in the offeror's proposal; (ii) A summary of the rationale for eliminating the offeror from the competition; and
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The first two required items are the same; the RFO text uses "must" for "shall" and moves them to paragraph (c)(1).

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(c)(1)(iii) says preaward debriefings must include reasonable responses to relevant questions about whether source selection procedures contained in the RFP, applicable regulations, and other applicable authorities were followed by the agency.
quote: (iii) Reasonable responses to relevant questions about whether source selection procedures contained in the RFP, applicable regulations, and other applicable authorities were followed by the agency.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO item ends "were followed by the agency" where the codified item ends "were followed in the process of eliminating the offeror from the competition", and says RFP where the codified text says solicitation.

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(d) says preaward debriefings must not disclose the number of offerors, the identity of other offerors, the content of other offerors proposals, the ranking of other offerors, the evaluation of other offerors, or any of the information prohibited in 15.301-1(d).
quote: (d) Nondisclosure. Preaward debriefings must not disclose— (1) The number of offerors; (2) The identity of other offerors; (3) The content of other offerors proposals; (4) The ranking of other offerors; (5) The evaluation of other offerors; or (6) Any of the information prohibited in 15.301-1(d).
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The six items are the same; the last item points to 15.301-1(d) where the codified item points to 15.506(e).

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(e) says contracting officers must make every effort to debrief the unsuccessful offeror as soon as practicable, but may refuse the request for a debriefing if, for compelling reasons, it is not in the best interests of the Government to conduct a debriefing at that time.
quote: (e) Delay until after award. Contracting officers must make every effort to debrief the unsuccessful offeror as soon as practicable, but may refuse the request for a debriefing if, for compelling reasons, it is not in the best interests of the Government to conduct a debriefing at that time.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same; the RFO text moves it to paragraph (e) and uses "must" for "shall".

statement: RFO FAR 15.206-2(e)(2) says that if the contracting officer delays the debriefing it must be provided no later than the time postaward debriefings are provided under 15.301-1, and that the contracting officer must then include the information at 15.301-1(c) in the debriefing.
quote: (2) If the contracting officer delays the debriefing, it must be provided no later than the time postaward debriefings are provided under 15.301-1. In that event, the contracting officer must include the information at 15.301-1(c) in the debriefing.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same; the cross-references are 15.301-1 and 15.301-1(c) where the codified text has 15.506 and 15.506(d).

statement: RFO FAR 15.407(a) says the purpose of performing cost or price analysis is to develop a negotiation position that permits the contracting officer and the offeror an opportunity to reach agreement on a fair and reasonable price.
quote: (a) The purpose of performing cost or price analysis is to develop a negotiation position that permits the contracting officer and the offeror an opportunity to reach agreement on a fair and reasonable price.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The first sentence is the same as codified FAR 15.405(a). The codified paragraph has the contracting officer take into consideration the advisory recommendations, reports of contributing specialists and the current status of the contractor's purchasing system before exercising the requisite judgment; RFO 15.407(a) says contracting officers are responsible for exercising the requisite judgment without that clause.

statement: RFO FAR 15.408-2(a) says contracting officers must document in the contract file the principal elements of the negotiated agreement, and that the documentation, for example a price negotiation memorandum, must include the listed items.
quote: (a) Contracting officers must document in the contract file the principal elements of the negotiated agreement. The documentation (e.g., price negotiation memorandum) must include the following:
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The duty is the same; the RFO text uses "must" for "shall" and drops the abbreviation "(PNM)".

statement: RFO FAR 15.408-2(a)(4) lists the current status of any contractor systems, for example purchasing, estimating, accounting and compensation, to the extent they affected and were considered in the negotiation.
quote: (4) The current status of any contractor systems (e.g., purchasing, estimating, accounting, and compensation) to the extent they affected and were considered in the negotiation.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same as codified FAR 15.406-3(a)(4).

statement: RFO FAR 15.408-2(a)(5) lists, if certified cost or pricing data were not required in the case of any price negotiation exceeding the certified cost or pricing data threshold, the exception used and the basis for it.
quote: (5) If certified cost or pricing data were not required in the case of any price negotiation exceeding the certified cost or pricing data threshold, the exception used and the basis for it.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same as codified FAR 15.406-3(a)(5).

statement: RFO FAR 15.408-2(a)(7) lists a summary of the contractor's proposal, any field pricing assistance recommendations, including the reasons for any pertinent variances from them, the Government's negotiation objective, and the negotiated position.
quote: (7) A summary of the contractor's proposal, any field pricing assistance recommendations, including the reasons for any pertinent variances from them, the Government's negotiation objective, and the negotiated position.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The first sentence of the item is the same as codified FAR 15.406-3(a)(7); the two sentences that follow it there are now subparagraphs (7)(i) and (7)(ii).

statement: RFO FAR 15.408-2(a)(7)(i) says that when the determination of a fair and reasonable price is based on cost analysis, the summary must address each major cost element.
quote: (i) When the determination of a fair and reasonable price is based on cost analysis, the summary must address each major cost element.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same as the second sentence of codified FAR 15.406-3(a)(7); it is now its own subparagraph (7)(i) and uses "must" for "shall".

statement: RFO FAR 15.408-2(a)(7)(ii) says that when determination of a fair and reasonable price is based on price analysis, the summary must include the source and type of data used to support the determination.
quote: (ii) When determination of a fair and reasonable price is based on price analysis, the summary must include the source and type of data used to support the determination.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same as the third sentence of codified FAR 15.406-3(a)(7); it is now its own subparagraph (7)(ii) and uses "must" for "shall".

statement: RFO FAR 15.408-2(a)(10) lists the basis for the profit or fee prenegotiation objective and the profit or fee negotiated.
quote: (10) The basis for the profit or fee prenegotiation objective and the profit or fee negotiated.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same as codified FAR 15.406-3(a)(10).

statement: In the RFO text of the contract pricing subpart, price means cost plus any fee or profit applicable to the contract type.
quote: As used in this subpart— Price means cost plus any fee or profit applicable to the contract type.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The definition of price is the same as in codified FAR 15.401.

statement: RFO FAR 15.401 says subcontract, except as used in 15.405-2, also includes a transfer of commercial products or commercial services between divisions, subsidiaries, or affiliates of a contractor or a subcontractor.
quote: Subcontract (except as used in 15.405-2) also includes a transfer of commercial products or commercial services between divisions, subsidiaries, or affiliates of a contractor or a subcontractor
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The definition is the same except that the exception points to 15.405-2 where the codified text points to 15.407-2; both texts end the sentence with the same citations to 10 U.S.C. 3701(2) and 41 U.S.C. 3501(a)(2).

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-3(b)(3)(iii)(A) says certified cost or pricing data are not required for modifications solely for overrun funding or interim billing price adjustments.
quote: (iii) Certified cost or pricing data are not required for modifications— (A) Solely for overrun funding or interim billing price adjustments;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO text states this as an exception for modifications inside the section on actions requiring certified cost or pricing data, where codified FAR 15.403-2(b) states it for proposals used solely for overrun funding or interim billing price adjustments.

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-3(b)(3)(iii)(B) says certified cost or pricing data are not required for modifications to exercise an option at the price established at contract award or initial negotiation.
quote: (iii) Certified cost or pricing data are not required for modifications— (A) Solely for overrun funding or interim billing price adjustments; or (B) To exercise an option at the price established at contract award or initial negotiation.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO text states this as an exception for modifications to exercise an option at the established price, where codified FAR 15.403-2(a) states that the exercise of an option at the established price does not require submission of certified cost or pricing data.

statement: RFO FAR 15.202(d) says agencies must purchase supplies and services from responsible sources at fair and reasonable prices.
quote: (d) Cost or price evaluation. Agencies must purchase supplies and services from responsible sources at fair and reasonable prices.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO text states the duty in the section on evaluating competitive proposals and addresses it to agencies, where codified FAR 15.402(a) addresses contracting officers.

statement: RFO FAR 15.402(a)(1) says that in establishing the reasonableness of the offered prices contracting officers must obtain certified cost or pricing data when required by 15.403-3, along with data other than certified cost or pricing data as necessary to establish a fair and reasonable price; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-EST-3369.
quote: In establishing the reasonableness of the offered prices, contracting officers must— (1) Obtain certified cost or pricing data when required by 15.403-3, along with data other than certified cost or pricing data as necessary to establish a fair and reasonable price; or
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same; the cross-reference is 15.403-3 where the codified text has 15.403-4, and the RFO text uses "must" for "shall".

statement: RFO FAR 15.402(a)(2) says that when certified cost or pricing data are not required by 15.403-3, contracting officers must obtain data other than certified cost or pricing data as necessary to establish a fair and reasonable price.
quote: (2) When certified cost or pricing data are not required by 15.403-3, obtain data other than certified cost or pricing data as necessary to establish a fair and reasonable price (10 U.S.C. 3705(a) and 41 U.S.C. 3505(a)).
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The paragraph does not carry the codified words "generally using the following order of preference" or the list; the RFO text puts the order of preference in 15.403-1(a).

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(a) says that for acquisitions that do not require certified cost or pricing data, contracting officers must generally use the listed order of preference to determine the type of data to require.
quote: (a) Order of preference. For acquisitions that do not require certified cost or pricing data, contracting officers must generally use the following order of preference to determine the type of data to require:
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The order of preference is the same idea as in codified FAR 15.402(a)(2), moved to its own paragraph in RFO 15.403-1.

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(a)(1) lists, first in the order of preference, no additional data from the offeror when adequate price competition exists.
quote: (1) No additional data from the offeror, when adequate price competition exists (see 15.403-2);
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The item does not carry the codified phrase "except as provided by 15.403-3(b)"; the RFO text states the unusual-circumstances rule in 15.403-1(e).

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(e) says that if adequate price competition exists but there are unusual circumstances in which additional data are necessary to determine the reasonableness of price, contracting officers must obtain the additional data from sources other than the offeror, to the maximum extent practicable.
quote: If adequate price competition exists, but there are unusual circumstances in which additional data are necessary to determine the reasonableness of price, contracting officers must obtain the additional data from sources other than the offeror, to the maximum extent practicable.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The sentence is the same as the second sentence of codified FAR 15.403-3(b), moved to RFO 15.403-1(e); the RFO text uses "must" for "shall" and says "in which" where the codified text says "where it is concluded that". The RFO first item of the order of preference does not carry the codified words "except as provided by 15.403-3(b)".

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(a)(2) lists data related to prices, for example established catalog or market prices and sales to non-governmental and governmental entities, relying first on data available within the Government.
quote: (2) Data related to prices (e.g., established catalog or market prices, sales to non-governmental and governmental entities), relying first on— (i) Data available within the Government; then
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The first source is the same as in codified FAR 15.402(a)(2)(ii)(A); the RFO text sets the sources out as items (i) to (iii).

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(a)(2)(ii) and (iii) continue the order with data obtained from sources other than the offeror and then, if necessary, data obtained from the offeror.
quote: (ii) Data obtained from sources other than the offeror; and then, if necessary, (iii) Data obtained from the offeror;
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The second and third sources are the same as in codified FAR 15.402(a)(2)(ii)(A).

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(a)(3) lists cost data to the extent necessary for the contracting officer to determine a fair and reasonable price.
quote: (3) Cost data to the extent necessary for the contracting officer to determine a fair and reasonable price.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The wording is the same as codified FAR 15.402(a)(2)(ii)(B).

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(b)(1) says contracting officers must require submission of data other than certified cost or pricing data to the extent necessary to determine a fair and reasonable price.
quote: (1) Contracting officers must require submission of data other than certified cost or pricing data to the extent necessary to determine a fair and reasonable price (10 U.S.C. 3705(a) and 41 U.S.C. 3505(a)).
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO text states the requirement as a separate paragraph, where codified FAR 15.402(a)(2)(ii)(A) states it as applying when obtaining data from the offeror is necessary.

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(b)(1) says that, at a minimum, the data must include appropriate data on the prices at which the same item or similar items have previously been sold, adequate for determining the reasonableness of the price.
quote: At a minimum, the data must include appropriate data on the prices at which the same item or similar items have previously been sold, adequate for determining the reasonableness of the price.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The minimum content is the same; the RFO text says "adequate for determining" where the codified text says "adequate for evaluating".

statement: RFO FAR 15.403-1(b)(1) says the prior-sale price data are not required when price reasonableness is established through adequate price competition or prices set by law or regulation, unless paragraph (e) of that subsection applies.
quote: This data is not required when price reasonableness is established through adequate price competition or prices set by law or regulation, unless paragraph (e) of this subsection applies.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The RFO text names the two cases and adds "unless paragraph (e) of this subsection applies", where the codified text says "unless an exception under 15.403-1(b)(1) or (2) applies".

statement: RFO FAR 15.402(b) says contracting officers must obtain the type and quantity of data necessary to establish a fair and reasonable price, but not more data than is needed.
quote: (b) Obtaining data. Contracting officers must obtain the type and quantity of data necessary to establish a fair and reasonable price, but not more data than is needed.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same; the RFO text moves it to paragraph (b) and says "needed" where the codified text says "necessary".

statement: RFO FAR 15.402(b) says contracting officers must require the submission of additional data sufficient for the contracting officer to support the determination of the fair and reasonable price, if the contracting officer cannot establish a fair and reasonable price from an analysis of the data obtained or submitted to date.
quote: must require the submission of additional data sufficient for the contracting officer to support the determination of the fair and reasonable price, if the contracting officer cannot establish a fair and reasonable price from an analysis of the data obtained or submitted to date.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The rule is the same; the RFO text says "an analysis" where the codified text says "the analyses" and uses "must" for "shall".

statement: RFO FAR 15.404-9(a) says the subsection prescribes policies for establishing the profit or fee portion of the Government prenegotiation objective in price negotiations based on cost analysis.
quote: (a) General. This subsection prescribes policies for establishing the profit or fee portion of the Government prenegotiation objective in price negotiations based on cost analysis.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). The sentence is the same as the first sentence of codified FAR 15.404-4(a).

statement: RFO FAR 15.404-9(a) is a general paragraph of one sentence on prescribing policies for establishing the profit or fee portion of the Government prenegotiation objective in price negotiations based on cost analysis, and paragraph (b) Policy follows it directly.
quote: (a) General. This subsection prescribes policies for establishing the profit or fee portion of the Government prenegotiation objective in price negotiations based on cost analysis. (b) Policy.
note: The RFO model text prints no date; effective_from is the date DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Revision 1 took effect (CL-EST-3177). Codified FAR 15.404-4(a)(1) goes on to say profit or fee prenegotiation objectives do not necessarily represent net income; RFO 15.404-9(a) is one sentence followed directly by paragraph (b), and a search of the RFO part 15 text finds the phrase net income nowhere.

statement: Under RFO FAR 15.404-9(c) (CL-EST-9525), contracting officers must not negotiate a price or fee that exceeds the following statutory limitations, imposed by 10 U.S.C. 3322(b) and 41 U.S.C. 3905.
