statement: Paragraph (b) applies to any filing person (other than the subject company) or any person specified in Instruction C that is not a natural person, and requires that person's principal business and state or other place of organization; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0278.
quote: (b) Business and background of entities. If any filing person (other than the subject company) or any person specified in Instruction C to the schedule is not a natural person, state the person's principal business, state or other place of organization,

statement: Paragraph (b) also requires, for each such person, the information that paragraphs (c)(3) and (c)(4) call for. Paragraph (c) requires the listed information for each filing person or person specified in Instruction C that is a natural person.
quote: and the information required by paragraphs (c)(3) and (c)(4) of this section for each person. (c) Business and background of natural persons. If any filing person or any person specified in Instruction C to the schedule is a natural person, provide the following information for each person:

statement: For each natural person, paragraph (c)(1) requires the current principal occupation or employment and the name, principal business and address of any corporation or other organization in which it is conducted.
quote: (1) Current principal occupation or employment and the name, principal business and address of any corporation or other organization in which the employment or occupation is conducted;

statement: For each natural person, paragraph (c)(2) requires the material occupations, positions, offices or employment during the past five years, giving the starting and ending dates of each and the name, principal business and address of any corporation or other organization in which each was carried on.
quote: (2) Material occupations, positions, offices or employment during the past five years, giving the starting and ending dates of each and the name, principal business and address of any corporation or other organization in which the occupation, position, office or employment was carried on;

statement: For each natural person, paragraph (c)(3) requires a statement whether or not the person was convicted in a criminal proceeding during the past five years, excluding traffic violations or similar misdemeanors.
quote: (3) A statement whether or not the person was convicted in a criminal proceeding during the past five years (excluding traffic violations or similar misdemeanors).

statement: If the person was convicted, paragraph (c)(3) requires a description of the criminal proceeding, including the dates, nature of conviction, name and location of court, and penalty imposed or other disposition of the case.
quote: If the person was convicted, describe the criminal proceeding, including the dates, nature of conviction, name and location of court, and penalty imposed or other disposition of the case;

statement: For each natural person, paragraph (c)(4) requires a statement whether or not the person was a party to any judicial or administrative proceeding during the past five years, except for matters dismissed without sanction or settlement; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0284.
quote: (4) A statement whether or not the person was a party to any judicial or administrative proceeding during the past five years (except for matters that were dismissed without sanction or settlement)

statement: The statement under paragraph (c)(4) covers a proceeding that resulted in a judgment, decree or final order enjoining the person from future violations of, or prohibiting activities subject to, federal or state securities laws, or a finding of any violation of federal or state securities laws; the quoted words complete the sentence in CL-MNA-0283.
quote: that resulted in a judgment, decree or final order enjoining the person from future violations of, or prohibiting activities subject to, federal or state securities laws, or a finding of any violation of federal or state securities laws.

statement: Paragraph (c)(4) requires a description of the proceeding, including a summary of the terms of the judgment, decree or final order, and paragraph (c)(5) requires the country of citizenship.
quote: Describe the proceeding, including a summary of the terms of the judgment, decree or final order; and (5) Country of citizenship.

statement: For a tender offer, paragraph (d) requires identification of the tender offer and the class of securities to which it relates and the name and address of the offeror, which may be based on the offeror's Schedule TO (§ 240.14d-100 of the same chapter) filed with the Commission.
quote: (d) Tender offer. Identify the tender offer and the class of securities to which the offer relates, the name of the offeror and its address (which may be based on the offeror's Schedule TO (§ 240.14d-100 of this chapter) filed with the Commission).

statement: Paragraph (a) requires the material terms of the transaction to be stated; for a tender offer the information must include the total number and class of securities sought and the type and amount of consideration offered to security holders; the quoted list continues in CL-MNA-0288.
quote: (a) Material terms. State the material terms of the transaction. (1) Tender offers. In the case of a tender offer, the information must include: (i) The total number and class of securities sought in the offer; (ii) The type and amount of consideration offered to security holders;

statement: The tender offer information must also include the scheduled expiration date, whether a subsequent offering period will be available if the transaction is a third-party tender offer, and whether the offer may be extended and, if so, how; the quoted list continues in CL-MNA-0289.
quote: (iii) The scheduled expiration date; (iv) Whether a subsequent offering period will be available, if the transaction is a third-party tender offer; (v) Whether the offer may be extended, and if so, how it could be extended;

statement: The tender offer information must also include the dates before and after which security holders may withdraw securities tendered in the offer, the procedures for tendering and withdrawing securities, and the manner in which securities will be accepted for payment; the quoted list continues in CL-MNA-0290.
quote: (vi) The dates before and after which security holders may withdraw securities tendered in the offer; (vii) The procedures for tendering and withdrawing securities; (viii) The manner in which securities will be accepted for payment;

statement: If the offer is for less than all securities of a class, the tender offer information must include the periods for accepting securities on a pro rata basis and the offeror's present intentions in the event that the offer is oversubscribed; the quoted list continues in CL-MNA-0291.
quote: (ix) If the offer is for less than all securities of a class, the periods for accepting securities on a pro rata basis and the offeror's present intentions in the event that the offer is oversubscribed;

statement: The tender offer information must include an explanation of any material differences in the rights of security holders as a result of the transaction, a brief statement as to the accounting treatment of the transaction, and the federal income tax consequences of the transaction, each if material.
quote: (x) An explanation of any material differences in the rights of security holders as a result of the transaction, if material; (xi) A brief statement as to the accounting treatment of the transaction, if material; and (xii) The federal income tax consequences of the transaction, if material.

statement: In the case of a merger or similar transaction, paragraph (a)(2) requires the information to include a brief description of the transaction, the consideration offered to security holders, the reasons for engaging in the transaction and the vote required for approval of the transaction; the quoted list continues in CL-MNA-0293.
quote: In the case of a merger or similar transaction, the information must include: (i) A brief description of the transaction; (ii) The consideration offered to security holders; (iii) The reasons for engaging in the transaction; (iv) The vote required for approval of the transaction;

statement: The merger information must also include an explanation of any material differences in the rights of security holders as a result of the transaction, a brief statement as to the accounting treatment of the transaction, and the federal income tax consequences of the transaction, each if material.
quote: (v) An explanation of any material differences in the rights of security holders as a result of the transaction, if material; (vi) A brief statement as to the accounting treatment of the transaction, if material; and (vii) The federal income tax consequences of the transaction, if material.

statement: Under the instruction to paragraph (a), if the consideration offered includes securities exempt from registration under the Securities Act of 1933, a description of the securities that complies with Item 202 of Regulation S-K (§ 229.202) is to be provided.
quote: Instruction to Item 1004(a): If the consideration offered includes securities exempt from registration under the Securities Act of 1933, provide a description of the securities that complies with Item 202 of Regulation S-K (§ 229.202).

statement: The description is not required if the issuer of the securities meets the requirements of the cited General Instructions of Form S-3 (§ 239.13 of the same chapter) and elects to furnish information by incorporation by reference; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and its further conditions continue in CL-MNA-0296 and CL-MNA-0297.
quote: This description is not required if the issuer of the securities meets the requirements of General Instructions I.A, I.B.1 or I.B.2, as applicable, or I.C. of Form S-3 (§ 239.13 of this chapter) and elects to furnish information by incorporation by reference;

statement: A further condition on relief from the description is that only capital stock is to be issued and that securities of the same class are registered under section 12 of the Exchange Act and either are listed for trading or admitted to unlisted trading privileges on a national securities exchange; the quoted words continue the sentence in CL-MNA-0295, and an alternative follows in CL-MNA-0297.
quote: only capital stock is to be issued; and securities of the same class are registered under section 12 of the Exchange Act and either are listed for trading or admitted to unlisted trading privileges on a national securities exchange;

statement: The sentence closes with a further alternative: the securities are ones for which bid and offer quotations are reported in an automated quotations system operated by a national securities association; the quoted words continue the sentence in CL-MNA-0296.
quote: or are securities for which bid and offer quotations are reported in an automated quotations system operated by a national securities association.

statement: Paragraph (b) requires a statement whether any securities are to be purchased from any officer, director or affiliate of the subject company, and the details of each transaction.
quote: (b) Purchases. State whether any securities are to be purchased from any officer, director or affiliate of the subject company and provide the details of each transaction.

statement: Paragraph (c) requires a description of any term or arrangement in the Rule 13e-3 transaction that treats any subject security holders differently from other subject security holders. Paragraph (d) requires a statement whether or not dissenting security holders are entitled to any appraisal rights and, if so, a summary of them.
quote: Describe any term or arrangement in the Rule 13e-3 transaction that treats any subject security holders differently from other subject security holders. (d) Appraisal rights. State whether or not dissenting security holders are entitled to any appraisal rights. If so, summarize the appraisal rights.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1007 requires the filing to state the specific sources and total amount of funds or other consideration to be used in the transaction.
quote: State the specific sources and total amount of funds or other consideration to be used in the transaction.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1007 requires that, if the transaction involves a tender offer, the filing disclose the amount of funds or other consideration required to purchase the maximum amount of securities sought in the offer.
quote: If the transaction involves a tender offer, disclose the amount of funds or other consideration required to purchase the maximum amount of securities sought in the offer.

statement: Paragraph (b) of Item 1007 requires the filing to state any material conditions to the financing discussed in response to paragraph (a), to disclose any alternative financing arrangements or alternative financing plans in the event the primary financing plans fall through, and to say so if there are none.
quote: State any material conditions to the financing discussed in response to paragraph (a) of this section. Disclose any alternative financing arrangements or alternative financing plans in the event the primary financing plans fall through. If none, so state.

statement: Paragraph (c) of Item 1007 requires the filing to furnish a reasonably itemized statement of all expenses incurred or estimated to be incurred in connection with the transaction, including, but not limited to, filing, legal, accounting and appraisal fees, solicitation expenses and printing costs; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0304.
quote: Furnish a reasonably itemized statement of all expenses incurred or estimated to be incurred in connection with the transaction including, but not limited to, filing, legal, accounting and appraisal fees, solicitation expenses and printing costs

statement: Paragraph (c) of Item 1007 also requires the filing to state whether or not the subject company has paid or will be responsible for paying any or all expenses.
quote: and state whether or not the subject company has paid or will be responsible for paying any or all expenses.

statement: Paragraph (d) of Item 1007 applies if all or any part of the funds or other consideration required is, or is expected to be, borrowed, directly or indirectly, for the purpose of the transaction; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0306.
quote: If all or any part of the funds or other consideration required is, or is expected, to be borrowed, directly or indirectly, for the purpose of the transaction:

statement: In that case paragraph (d)(1) requires the filing to provide a summary of each loan agreement or arrangement containing the identity of the parties, the term, the collateral, the stated and effective interest rates, and any other material terms or conditions of the loan; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0307.
quote: Provide a summary of each loan agreement or arrangement containing the identity of the parties, the term, the collateral, the stated and effective interest rates, and any other material terms or conditions of the loan

statement: In that case paragraph (d)(2) requires the filing to briefly describe any plans or arrangements to finance or repay the loan or, if no plans or arrangements have been made, to say so.
quote: Briefly describe any plans or arrangements to finance or repay the loan, or, if no plans or arrangements have been made, so state.

statement: The Instruction to Item 1007(d) applies if the transaction is a third-party tender offer and the source of all or any part of the funds used in the transaction is to come from a loan made in the ordinary course of business by a bank as defined by section 3(a)(6) of the Act; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0309.
quote: If the transaction is a third-party tender offer and the source of all or any part of the funds used in the transaction is to come from a loan made in the ordinary course of business by a bank as defined by section 3(a)(6) of the Act (15 U.S.C. 78c)

statement: In that case the Instruction to Item 1007(d) says that the name of the bank will not be made available to the public if the filing person so requests in writing and files the request, naming the bank, with the Secretary of the Commission.
quote: the name of the bank will not be made available to the public if the filing person so requests in writing and files the request, naming the bank, with the Secretary of the Commission.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1008 requires the filing to state the aggregate number and percentage of subject securities beneficially owned by each person named in response to Item 1003 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1003) and by each associate and majority-owned subsidiary of those persons.
quote: State the aggregate number and percentage of subject securities that are beneficially owned by each person named in response to Item 1003 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1003) and by each associate and majority-owned subsidiary of those persons.

statement: Instruction 1 to Item 1008(a) says that, for purposes of the section, beneficial ownership is determined under Rule 13d-3 under the Exchange Act, and that the filing must identify the shares that the person has a right to acquire.
quote: For purposes of this section, beneficial ownership is determined in accordance with Rule 13d-3 (§ 240.13d-3 of this chapter) under the Exchange Act. Identify the shares that the person has a right to acquire.

statement: Instruction 2 to Item 1008(a) says that the information required by the section may be based on the number of outstanding securities disclosed in the subject company's most recently available filing with the Commission, unless the filing person has more current information.
quote: The information required by this section may be based on the number of outstanding securities disclosed in the subject company's most recently available filing with the Commission, unless the filing person has more current information.

statement: Instruction 3 to Item 1008(a) says that the information required by the section with respect to officers, directors and associates of the subject company must be given to the extent known after making reasonable inquiry.
quote: The information required by this section with respect to officers, directors and associates of the subject company must be given to the extent known after making reasonable inquiry.

statement: Paragraph (b) of Item 1008 requires the filing to describe any transaction in the subject securities during the past 60 days.
quote: Describe any transaction in the subject securities during the past 60 days.

statement: Instruction 2 to Item 1008(b) says that, if the transaction information is not initially available, it must be obtained and filed with the Commission promptly, but in no event later than three business days after the date of the initial filing, and, if material, disclosed in a manner reasonably designed to inform security holders.
quote: If the information is not initially available, it must be obtained and filed with the Commission promptly, but in no event later than three business days after the date of the initial filing, and if material, disclosed in a manner reasonably designed to inform security holders.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1009 requires the filing to identify all persons and classes of persons that are directly or indirectly employed, retained or to be compensated to make solicitations or recommendations in connection with the transaction.
quote: Identify all persons and classes of persons that are directly or indirectly employed, retained, or to be compensated to make solicitations or recommendations in connection with the transaction.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1009 also requires the filing to provide a summary of all material terms of employment, retainer or other arrangement for compensation.
quote: Provide a summary of all material terms of employment, retainer or other arrangement for compensation.

statement: Paragraph (b) of Item 1009 requires the filing to identify any officer, class of employees or corporate assets of the subject company that has been or will be employed or used by the filing person in connection with the transaction, and to describe the purpose for their employment or use.
quote: Identify any officer, class of employees or corporate assets of the subject company that has been or will be employed or used by the filing person in connection with the transaction. Describe the purpose for their employment or use.

statement: The Instruction to Item 1009(b) says to provide all information required by Item 1009 except for the information required by paragraph (a) of that section and Item 1007 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1007).
quote: Provide all information required by this Item except for the information required by paragraph (a) of this section and Item 1007 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1007).

statement: Paragraph (a)(1) of Item 1010 requires the filing to furnish audited financial statements for the two fiscal years required to be filed with the company's most recent annual report under sections 13 and 15(d) of the Exchange Act.
quote: Furnish the following financial information: (1) Audited financial statements for the two fiscal years required to be filed with the company's most recent annual report under sections 13 and 15(d) of the Exchange Act (15 U.S.C. 78m; 15 U.S.C. 78o);

statement: Paragraph (a)(2) of Item 1010 requires the filing to furnish unaudited balance sheets, comparative year-to-date statements of comprehensive income (as defined in Regulation S-X), related earnings per share data and statements of cash flows; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0322.
quote: Unaudited balance sheets, comparative year-to-date statements of comprehensive income (as defined in § 210.1-02 of Regulation S-X of this chapter) and related earnings per share data and statements of cash flows

statement: Under paragraph (a)(2) of Item 1010, the unaudited statements furnished are those required to be included in the company's most recent quarterly report filed under the Exchange Act.
quote: required to be included in the company's most recent quarterly report filed under the Exchange Act;

statement: Paragraph (a)(4) of Item 1010 requires the filing to furnish book value per share as of the date of the most recent balance sheet presented.
quote: Book value per share as of the date of the most recent balance sheet presented.

statement: Paragraph (b) of Item 1010 says that, if material, the filing must furnish pro forma information disclosing the effect of the transaction on the items listed in paragraphs (b)(1) to (b)(3); the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0325.
quote: (b) Pro forma information. If material, furnish pro forma information disclosing the effect of the transaction on:

statement: Under paragraph (b)(1) of Item 1010, the pro forma information covers the company's balance sheet as of the date of the most recent balance sheet presented under paragraph (a).
quote: (1) The company's balance sheet as of the date of the most recent balance sheet presented under paragraph (a) of this section;

statement: Under paragraph (b)(3) of Item 1010, the pro forma information also covers the company's book value per share as of the date of the most recent balance sheet presented under paragraph (a).
quote: (3) The company's book value per share as of the date of the most recent balance sheet presented under paragraph (a) of this section.

statement: Paragraph (c) of Item 1010 requires the filing to furnish a fair and adequate summary of the information specified in paragraphs (a) and (b) for the same periods specified.
quote: Furnish a fair and adequate summary of the information specified in paragraphs (a) and (b) of this section for the same periods specified.

statement: Under paragraphs (c)(5) and (c)(6) of Item 1010, a fair and adequate summary includes book value per share as of the date of the most recent balance sheet and, if material, pro forma data for the summarized financial information specified in paragraphs (c)(1) through (c)(5), disclosing the effect of the transaction.
quote: (5) Book value per share as of the date of the most recent balance sheet; and (6) If material, pro forma data for the summarized financial information specified in paragraphs (c)(1) through (c)(5) of this section disclosing the effect of the transaction.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1011 says that, if the information is material to a security holder's decision whether to sell, tender or hold the securities sought in the tender offer, the filing must furnish the information listed in paragraphs (a)(1) to (a)(5); the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0330.
quote: If material to a security holder's decision whether to sell, tender or hold the securities sought in the tender offer, furnish the following information:

statement: Paragraph (a)(1) of Item 1011 calls for any present or proposed material agreement, arrangement, understanding or relationship between the offeror or any of its executive officers, directors, controlling persons or subsidiaries and the subject company or any of its executive officers, directors, controlling persons or subsidiaries; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0331.
quote: (1) Any present or proposed material agreement, arrangement, understanding or relationship between the offeror or any of its executive officers, directors, controlling persons or subsidiaries and the subject company or any of its executive officers, directors, controlling persons or subsidiaries

statement: Paragraph (a)(1) of Item 1011 excludes any agreement, arrangement or understanding disclosed under any other sections of Regulation M-A (§§ 229.1000 through 229.1016).
quote: (other than any agreement, arrangement or understanding disclosed under any other sections of Regulation M-A (§§ 229.1000 through 229.1016))

statement: The Instruction to paragraph (a)(1) of Item 1011 says that, in an issuer tender offer, the filing must disclose any material agreement, arrangement, understanding or relationship between the offeror and any of its executive officers, directors, controlling persons or subsidiaries.
quote: In an issuer tender offer disclose any material agreement, arrangement, understanding or relationship between the offeror and any of its executive officers, directors, controlling persons or subsidiaries.

statement: Paragraph (a)(2) of Item 1011 calls for the applicable regulatory requirements that must be complied with or approvals that must be obtained in connection with the tender offer, to the extent known by the offeror after reasonable investigation.
quote: To the extent known by the offeror after reasonable investigation, the applicable regulatory requirements which must be complied with or approvals which must be obtained in connection with the tender offer;

statement: Paragraph (a)(3) of Item 1011 calls for the applicability of any anti-trust laws.
quote: The applicability of any anti-trust laws;

statement: Paragraph (a)(4) of Item 1011 calls for the applicability of margin requirements under section 7 of the Act and the applicable regulations.
quote: The applicability of margin requirements under section 7 of the Act (15 U.S.C. 78g) and the applicable regulations;

statement: Paragraph (a)(5) of Item 1011 calls for any material pending legal proceedings relating to the tender offer, including the name and location of the court or agency in which the proceedings are pending, the date instituted, the principal parties, and a brief summary of the proceedings and the relief sought.
quote: Any material pending legal proceedings relating to the tender offer, including the name and location of the court or agency in which the proceedings are pending, the date instituted, the principal parties, and a brief summary of the proceedings and the relief sought.

statement: The Instruction to Item 1011(a)(5) says that a copy of any document relating to a major development (such as pleadings, an answer, complaint, temporary restraining order, injunction, opinion, judgment or order) in a material pending legal proceeding must be furnished promptly to the Commission staff on a supplemental basis.
quote: A copy of any document relating to a major development (such as pleadings, an answer, complaint, temporary restraining order, injunction, opinion, judgment or order) in a material pending legal proceeding must be furnished promptly to the Commission staff on a supplemental basis.

statement: Paragraph (c) of Item 1011 requires the filing to furnish such additional material information, if any, as may be necessary to make the required statements, in light of the circumstances under which they are made, not materially misleading.
quote: Furnish such additional material information, if any, as may be necessary to make the required statements, in light of the circumstances under which they are made, not materially misleading.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1012 requires the filing to state the nature of the solicitation or the recommendation and, if the statement relates to a recommendation, to state whether the filing person is advising holders of the subject securities to accept or reject the tender offer or to take other action; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0340.
quote: State the nature of the solicitation or the recommendation. If this statement relates to a recommendation, state whether the filing person is advising holders of the subject securities to accept or reject the tender offer or to take other action

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1012 requires the filing to describe the other action recommended, if the filing person is advising other action with respect to the tender offer.
quote: with respect to the tender offer and, if so, describe the other action recommended.

statement: Paragraph (a) of Item 1012 requires a filing person that is the subject company and is not making a recommendation to state whether the subject company is expressing no opinion and is remaining neutral toward the tender offer or is unable to take a position with respect to it.
quote: If the filing person is the subject company and is not making a recommendation, state whether the subject company is expressing no opinion and is remaining neutral toward the tender offer or is unable to take a position with respect to the tender offer.

statement: Paragraph (b) of Item 1012 requires the filing to state the reasons for the position (including the inability to take a position) stated in paragraph (a).
quote: State the reasons for the position (including the inability to take a position) stated in paragraph (a) of this section.

statement: Paragraph (c) of Item 1012 requires the filing, to the extent known by the filing person after making reasonable inquiry, to state whether the filing person or any executive officer, director, affiliate or subsidiary of the filing person currently intends to tender, sell or hold the subject securities; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0344.
quote: To the extent known by the filing person after making reasonable inquiry, state whether the filing person or any executive officer, director, affiliate or subsidiary of the filing person currently intends to tender, sell or hold the subject securities

statement: The securities covered by the paragraph (c) statement of intent are those held of record or beneficially owned by that person.
quote: that are held of record or beneficially owned by that person.

statement: Paragraph (d) of Item 1012, headed intent to tender or vote in a going-private transaction, requires the filing, to the extent known by the filing person after making reasonable inquiry, to state whether or not any executive officer, director or affiliate of the issuer (or any person specified in Instruction C to the schedule); the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-1110.
quote: (d) Intent to tender or vote in a going-private transaction. To the extent known by the filing person after making reasonable inquiry, state whether or not any executive officer, director or affiliate of the issuer (or any person specified in Instruction C to the schedule)

statement: Paragraph (d) of Item 1012 also covers, using the words "and/or", how each person currently intends to vote subject securities, including any securities the person has proxy authority for.
quote: and/or how each person currently intends to vote subject securities, including any securities the person has proxy authority for.

statement: Paragraph (d) of Item 1012 also requires the filing to state the reasons for the intended action.
quote: State the reasons for the intended action.

statement: The Instruction to Item 1012(d) says that, if the information is not available, it must be filed with the Commission promptly, but in no event later than three business days after the date of the initial filing, and, if material, disclosed in a manner reasonably designed to inform security holders.
quote: If the information is not available, it must be filed with the Commission promptly, but in no event later than three business days after the date of the initial filing, and if material, disclosed in a manner reasonably designed to inform security holders.

statement: Paragraph (e) of Item 1012 requires the filing, to the extent known by the filing person after making reasonable inquiry, to state whether or not any person specified in paragraph (d) has made a recommendation either in support of or opposed to the transaction and the reasons for the recommendation.
quote: To the extent known by the filing person after making reasonable inquiry, state whether or not any person specified in paragraph (d) of this section has made a recommendation either in support of or opposed to the transaction and the reasons for the recommendation.

statement: The contracting officer responsible for processing and executing novation and change-of-name agreements is determined by the rules set out in 42.1202.
quote: The contracting officer responsible for processing and executing novation and change-of-name agreements shall be determined as follows:

statement: If any of the affected contracts held by the transferor have been assigned to an administrative contracting officer, one alternative is that administrative contracting officer as the responsible contracting officer; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0451.
quote: (a) If any of the affected contracts held by the transferor have been assigned to an administrative contracting officer (ACO) (see 2.1 and 42.202), the responsible contracting officer shall be— (1) This ACO; or
note: Another claim carries the second alternative in paragraph (a)(2).

statement: If none of the affected contracts held by the transferor has been assigned to an ACO, the contracting officer responsible for the largest unsettled dollar balance of contracts is the responsible contracting officer.
quote: (b) If none of the affected contracts held by the transferor have been assigned to an ACO, the contracting officer responsible for the largest unsettled (unbilled plus billed but unpaid) dollar balance of contracts shall be the responsible contracting officer.

statement: If several transferors are involved, the responsible contracting officer is, as one of two alternatives, the ACO administering the largest unsettled dollar balance; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0368.
quote: (c) If several transferors are involved, the responsible contracting officer shall be— (1) The ACO administering the largest unsettled dollar balance; or

statement: A contractor that wants the Government to recognize a successor in interest or a name change must submit a written request to the responsible contracting officer.
quote: (a) If a contractor wishes the Government to recognize a successor in interest to its contracts or a name change, the contractor must submit a written request to the responsible contracting officer (see 42.1202).
note: The next sentence of the section carries an exception for contracts received under subpart 8.7, which another claim states.

statement: The responsible contracting officer identifies the information necessary to evaluate a proposed successor-in-interest or name-change agreement and requests that the contractor submit it.
quote: (b) The responsible contracting officer shall— (1) Identify and request that the contractor submit the information necessary to evaluate the proposed agreement for recognizing a successor in interest or a name change.

statement: One listed step for a proposed successor-in-interest agreement is to notify each affected contract administration office and contracting office and give those offices a list of all affected contracts; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0357.
quote: (2) Notify each contract administration office and contracting office affected by a proposed agreement for recognizing a successor in interest, and provide those offices with a list of all affected contracts; and
note: The lead-in that makes the listed steps the responsible contracting officer's duties is quoted in the claim on the information request.

statement: One listed step is to request submission of any comments or objections to the proposed transfer within 30 days after notification.
quote: (3) Request submission of any comments or objections to the proposed transfer within 30 days after notification.
note: The lead-in that makes the listed steps the responsible contracting officer's duties is quoted in the claim on the information request.

statement: Upon receipt of the necessary information, the responsible contracting officer determines whether or not it is in the Government's interest to recognize the proposed successor in interest, on the basis of the items listed in the section; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0452.
quote: Upon receipt of the necessary information, the responsible contracting officer shall determine whether or not it is in the Government's interest to recognize the proposed successor in interest on the basis of—
note: Separate claims carry each listed basis.

statement: One listed basis for the recognition determination is any factor relating to the proposed successor's performance of contracts with the Government that the Government determines would impair the proposed successor's ability to perform the contract satisfactorily.
quote: (3) Any factor relating to the proposed successor's performance of contracts with the Government that the Government determines would impair the proposed successor's ability to perform the contract satisfactorily.
note: The lead-in that makes these the bases of the determination is quoted in the previous claim.

statement: Executing a novation agreement does not prevent the contracting officer from using any other available method to resolve other issues related to a transfer of contractor assets, including the treatment of costs.
quote: (d) The execution of a novation agreement does not preclude the use of any other method available to the contracting officer to resolve any other issues related to a transfer of contractor assets, including the treatment of costs.

statement: Any separate agreement between the transferor and transferee regarding the assumption of liabilities should be referenced specifically in the novation agreement; the word separate comes from the lead-in quoted in CL-MNA-1566.
quote: agreement between the transferor and transferee regarding the assumption of liabilities (e.g., long-term incentive compensation plans, cost accounting standards noncompliances, environmental cleanup costs, and final overhead costs) should be referenced specifically in the novation agreement.

statement: Before novation and change-of-name agreements are executed, the responsible contracting officer must ensure that Government counsel has reviewed them for legal sufficiency.
quote: (f) Before novation and change-of-name agreements are executed, the responsible contracting officer shall ensure that Government counsel has reviewed them for legal sufficiency.

statement: Following distribution of the executed agreement, the responsible contracting officer prepares a Standard Form 30 that summarizes the agreement and attaches a complete list of the contracts affected.
quote: (h) Following distribution of the agreement, the responsible contracting officer shall— (1) Prepare a Standard Form 30, Amendment of Solicitation/Modification of Contract, incorporating a summary of the agreement and attaching a complete list of contracts affected;

statement: If only a change of the contractor's name is involved and the rights and obligations of the Government and the contractor remain unaffected, the parties must execute an agreement to reflect the name change.
quote: (a) If only a change of the contractor's name is involved and the Government's and contractor's rights and obligations remain unaffected, the parties shall execute an agreement to reflect the name change.

statement: The contractor forwards three signed copies of the Change-of-Name Agreement to the responsible contracting officer, with one copy of the document effecting the name change, authenticated by a proper official of the State having jurisdiction.
quote: The contractor shall forward to the responsible contracting officer three signed copies of the Change-of-Name Agreement, and one copy each of the following: (1) The document effecting the name change, authenticated by a proper official of the State having jurisdiction.

statement: One listed document is the opinion of the contractor's legal counsel stating that the change of name was properly effected under applicable law and showing the effective date.
quote: (2) The opinion of the contractor's legal counsel stating that the change of name was properly effected under applicable law and showing the effective date.
note: The lead-in that makes this a document the contractor forwards is quoted in the previous claim.

statement: One listed document is a list of all affected contracts and purchase orders remaining unsettled between the contractor and the Government, showing for each the contract number and type and the name and address of the contracting office.
quote: (3) A list of all affected contracts and purchase orders remaining unsettled between the contractor and the Government, showing for each the contract number and type, and name and address of the contracting office.
note: The lead-in that makes this a document the contractor forwards is quoted in the claim on the document effecting the name change.

statement: The other alternative when several transferors are involved is the contracting officer or ACO designated by the agency having the largest unsettled dollar balance, if none of the affected contracts has been assigned to an ACO.
quote: (2) The contracting officer (or ACO) designated by the agency having the largest unsettled dollar balance, if none of the affected contracts have been assigned to an ACO.
note: The lead-in that makes this the second alternative is quoted in the previous claim on several transferors.

statement: The DoD external restructuring cost principle prescribes policies and procedures for allowing contractor external restructuring costs when savings would result for DoD.
quote: (a) Scope. This subsection— (1) Prescribes policies and procedures for allowing contractor external restructuring costs when savings would result for DoD;

statement: A business combination is a transaction in which the assets or operations of two or more companies not previously under common ownership or control are combined, whether by merger, acquisition, or sale or purchase of assets.
quote: (1) Business combination means a transaction whereby assets or operations of two or more companies not previously under common ownership or control are combined, whether by merger, acquisition, or sale/purchase of assets.

statement: External restructuring activities are restructuring activities occurring after a business combination that affect the operations of companies not previously under common ownership or control.
quote: (2) External restructuring activities means restructuring activities occurring after a business combination that affect the operations of companies not previously under common ownership or control.

statement: External restructuring activities normally will be initiated within 3 years of the business combination.
quote: External restructuring activities are a direct outgrowth of a business combination. They normally will be initiated within 3 years of the business combination.

statement: Restructuring costs that may be allowed include severance pay, early retirement incentive payments, employee retraining costs, relocation expense for retained employees, and relocation and rearrangement of plant and equipment.
quote: Restructuring costs that may be allowed include, but are not limited to, severance pay for employees, early retirement incentive payments for employees, employee retraining costs, relocation expense for retained employees, and relocation and rearrangement of plant and equipment.

statement: Restructuring costs associated with external restructuring activities that are allocated to DoD contracts and are less than $2.5 million are not subject to the audit, review, and determination requirements of paragraph (c)(4) of the cost principle.
quote: if restructuring costs associated with external restructuring activities allocated to DoD contracts are less than $2.5 million, the costs shall not be subject to the audit, review, and determination requirements of paragraph (c)(4) of this subsection;
note: Another claim carries the sentence that follows, which sends such costs to the normal allowability rules.

statement: External restructuring costs are not allowed unless they are allowable under FAR part 31 and DFARS part 231 and an audit of projected restructuring costs and restructuring savings is performed, among the other listed conditions.
quote: Restructuring costs associated with external restructuring activities shall not be allowed unless— (1) Such costs are allowable in accordance with FAR part 31 and DFARS part 231; (2) An audit of projected restructuring costs and restructuring savings is performed;
note: The next two claims carry the remaining listed conditions.

statement: Another listed condition is that the cognizant ACO reviews the audit report and the projected costs and savings and negotiates an advance agreement; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0377 and CL-MNA-0378.
quote: (3) The cognizant administrative contracting officer (ACO) reviews the audit report and the projected costs and projected savings, and negotiates an advance agreement in accordance with paragraph (d) of this subsection; and
note: The lead-in that makes this a condition of allowance is quoted in the previous claim.

statement: A further listed condition is a written determination by the designated official that the audited projected savings for DoD, on a present value basis, will exceed either the costs allowed by a factor of at least two to one or a second alternative; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0378.
quote: (4) (i) The official designated in paragraph (c)(4)(ii) of this subsection determines in writing that the audited projected savings, on a present value basis, for DoD resulting from the restructuring will exceed either— (A) The costs allowed by a factor of at least two to one; or
note: The second alternative, about preserving a critical capability, is in the next claim.

statement: One of the two alternatives for the written savings determination is the costs allowed, together with the business combination resulting in the preservation of a critical capability that might otherwise be lost to DoD.
quote: (B) The costs allowed, and the business combination will result in the preservation of a critical capability that might otherwise be lost to DoD.

statement: If restructuring costs are expected to exceed $25 million over a 5-year period, the designated official is the Under Secretary of Defense (Acquisition and Sustainment) or the Principal Deputy, and this authority may not be delegated below the level of an Assistant Secretary of Defense.
quote: (A) If the amount of restructuring costs is expected to exceed $25 million over a 5-year period, the designated official is the Under Secretary of Defense (Acquisition and Sustainment) or the Principal Deputy. This authority may not be delegated below the level of an Assistant Secretary of Defense.

statement: In all other cases the designated official is the Director of the Defense Contract Management Agency, who may not delegate this authority.
quote: (B) For all other cases, the designated official is the Director of the Defense Contract Management Agency. The Director may not delegate this authority.

statement: When a novation agreement is required and the transferee intends to incur restructuring costs as defined at the section the paragraph cross-references, the cognizant contracting officer must include a DoD-specified provision as paragraph (b)(7) of the novation agreement; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0456.
quote: (i) When a novation agreement is required and the transferee intends to incur restructuring costs as defined at 213.205-70, the cognizant contracting officer shall include the following provision as paragraph (b)(7) of the novation agreement
note: The printed cross-reference reads 213.205-70.

statement: Under the DoD paragraph, the proviso for reimbursement is that the transferee demonstrates that the restructuring will reduce overall costs to DoD (and to NASA where there is a mix of DoD and NASA contracts) and that the requirements included in DFARS 231.205-70 are met.
quote: provided the Transferee demonstrates that the restructuring will reduce overall costs to the Department of Defense (DoD) (and to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), where there is a mix of DoD and NASA contracts), and the requirements included in DFARS 231.205-70 are met.
note: The printed text spells the word flexibly-priced as flexibily-priced, and the same paragraph also covers costs allowable under FAR part 31 and requires that the DoD restructuring cost principle requirements be met.

statement: Under the DoD paragraph, restructuring costs are not allowed on novated contracts unless there is an audit of the restructuring proposal and a determination by the contracting officer of overall reduced costs to DoD or NASA, among the stated conditions.
quote: Restructuring costs shall not be allowed on novated contracts unless there is an audit of the restructuring proposal; a determination by the contracting officer of overall reduced costs to DoD/NASA;
note: The advance agreement condition is in the next claim.

statement: The list of conditions under the DoD paragraph ends with an advance agreement setting forth a cumulative cost ceiling for restructuring projects and the period to which such costs are assigned.
quote: and an Advance Agreement setting forth a cumulative cost ceiling for restructuring projects and the period to which such costs shall be assigned.
note: The lead-in that makes this a condition of allowing the costs is quoted in the previous claim.

statement: A predecessor is an entity that is replaced by a successor, and the term includes any predecessors of the predecessor.
quote: Predecessor means an entity that is replaced by a successor and includes any predecessors of the predecessor.

statement: A successor is an entity that has replaced a predecessor by acquiring the assets and carrying out the affairs of the predecessor under a new name.
quote: Successor means an entity that has replaced a predecessor by acquiring the assets and carrying out the affairs of the predecessor under a new name (often through acquisition or merger).

statement: The term successor does not include new offices or divisions of the same company or a company that only changes its name.
quote: The term “successor” does not include new offices/divisions of the same company or a company that only changes its name.

statement: In the provision, the offeror represents whether or not it is a successor to a predecessor that held a Federal contract or grant within the last three years.
quote: (b) The Offeror represents that it □ is or □ is not a successor to a predecessor that held a Federal contract or grant within the last three years.

statement: An offeror that indicates it is a successor enters the following information for all predecessors that held a Federal contract or grant within the last three years, listing the predecessors in reverse chronological order if there is more than one.
quote: (c) If the Offeror has indicated “is” in paragraph (b) of this provision, enter the following information for all predecessors that held a Federal contract or grant within the last three years (if more than one predecessor, list in reverse chronological order):
note: Another claim carries the CAGE code line that follows.

statement: The offeror also enters the predecessor's legal name and does not use a doing-business-as name.
quote: Predecessor legal name: ________. (Do not use a “doing business as” name).

statement: A segment closing means that a segment has been sold or ownership has been otherwise transferred, has discontinued operations, or has discontinued doing or actively seeking Government business under contracts subject to the Standard.
quote: (20) Segment closing means that a segment has (i) been sold or ownership has been otherwise transferred, (ii) discontinued operations, or (iii) discontinued doing or actively seeking Government business under contracts subject to this Standard.

statement: If a segment is closed, if there is a pension plan termination, or if there is a curtailment of benefits, the contractor must determine the difference between the actuarial accrued liability for the segment and the market value of the assets allocated to the segment.
quote: If a segment is closed, if there is a pension plan termination, or if there is a curtailment of benefits, the contractor shall determine the difference between the actuarial accrued liability for the segment and the market value of the assets allocated to the segment
note: The same sentence adds that this applies irrespective of whether or not the pension plan is terminated.

statement: The difference between the market value of the assets and the actuarial accrued liability for the segment represents an adjustment of previously-determined pension costs.
quote: The difference between the market value of the assets and the actuarial accrued liability for the segment represents an adjustment of previously-determined pension costs.

statement: The actuarial accrued liability for the adjustment is determined using the accrued benefit cost method, with actuarial assumptions consistent with the current and prior long term assumptions used in measuring pension costs.
quote: (i) The determination of the actuarial accrued liability shall be made using the accrued benefit cost method. The actuarial assumptions employed shall be consistent with the current and prior long term assumptions used in the measurement of pension costs.

statement: In computing the market value of the segment's assets, the market value is reduced by the accumulated value of prepayment credits, if any, and increased by the current value of any separately identified unfunded actuarial liability.
quote: The market value of the assets shall be reduced by the accumulated value of prepayment credits, if any. Conversely, the market value of the assets shall be increased by the current value of any unfunded actuarial liability separately identified and maintained in accordance with 9904.412-50(a)(2).

statement: The difference is calculated as of the date of the event, such as contract termination, plan amendment or plant closure, that caused the closing of the segment; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0092.
quote: (iii) The calculation of the difference between the market value of the assets and the actuarial accrued liability shall be made as of the date of the event (e.g., contract termination, plan amendment, plant closure) that caused the closing of the segment
note: The same sentence applies the same date to a pension plan termination or curtailment of benefits, and the paragraph lets the contracting parties agree on a date if the event date is not readily determinable or its use can result in an inequitable calculation.

statement: Pension plan improvements adopted within 60 months of the event date that increase the actuarial accrued liability are recognized on a prorata basis using the number of months the adoption date preceded the event date.
quote: (iv) Pension plan improvements adopted within 60 months of the date of the event which increase the actuarial accrued liability shall be recognized on a prorata basis using the number of months the date of adoption preceded the event date.
note: The same paragraph exempts plan improvements mandated by law or collective bargaining agreement from this phase-in.

statement: No adjustment amount is required when a segment is closed through a transfer of ownership to a successor in interest in the segment's contracts and all of the plan assets and actuarial accrued liabilities pertaining to the closed segment are transferred to the successor segment.
quote: transfer of ownership to a successor in interest in the contracts of the segment and all of the pension plan assets and actuarial accrued liabilities pertaining to the closed segment are transferred to the successor segment, then no adjustment amount pursuant to this paragraph (c)(12) is required.
note: The paragraph begins with a segment closed due to a sale or other transfer of ownership, and says that if only some of the assets and liabilities are transferred, the adjustment is based on those remaining with the contractor.

statement: The Government's share of the adjustment amount for a segment is the product of the adjustment amount and a fraction, and the adjustment amount is reduced for any excise tax imposed on assets withdrawn from the funding agency of a qualified pension plan.
quote: (vi) The Government's share of the adjustment amount determined for a segment shall be the product of the adjustment amount and a fraction. The adjustment amount shall be reduced for any excise tax imposed upon assets withdrawn from the funding agency of a qualified pension plan.

statement: The statement for the transaction must state the purposes for the Rule 13e-3 transaction.
quote: State the purposes for the Rule 13e-3 transaction.
note: The packet prints no RFO counterpart for this section, so the RFO citation is omitted.

statement: The statement must describe alternative means to the stated purposes that the subject company or affiliate considered, and must state the reasons for their rejection; the duty applies if the subject company or affiliate considered such alternatives.
quote: If the subject company or affiliate considered alternative means to accomplish the stated purposes, briefly describe the alternatives and state the reasons for their rejection.

statement: The statement must state the reasons for the structure of the transaction and for undertaking it at that time.
quote: State the reasons for the structure of the Rule 13e-3 transaction and for undertaking the transaction at this time.

statement: The statement must describe the effects of the transaction on the subject company, its affiliates and unaffiliated security holders, including the federal tax consequences.
quote: Describe the effects of the Rule 13e-3 transaction on the subject company, its affiliates and unaffiliated security holders, including the federal tax consequences of the transaction.

statement: Conclusory statements are not sufficient disclosure in response to the purposes, alternatives, reasons and effects item.
quote: Conclusory statements will not be considered sufficient disclosure in response to this section.

statement: The effects description must include a reasonably detailed discussion of both the benefits and the detriments of the transaction to the subject company, its affiliates and unaffiliated security holders.
quote: The description required by paragraph (d) of this section must include a reasonably detailed discussion of both the benefits and detriments of the Rule 13e-3 transaction to the subject company, its affiliates and unaffiliated security holders.

statement: The benefits and the detriments of the transaction must be quantified to the extent practicable.
quote: The benefits and detriments of the Rule 13e-3 transaction must be quantified to the extent practicable.

statement: Where the statement is filed by an affiliate of the subject company, the effects description must include, but not be limited to, the matter that CL-MNA-0408 quotes; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0408.
quote: If this statement is filed by an affiliate of the subject company, the description required by paragraph (d) of this section must include, but not be limited to

statement: The description must show the effect of the transaction on the affiliate's interest in the net book value and net earnings of the subject company in terms of both dollar amounts and percentages; this fragment completes the sentence begun in CL-MNA-0407.
quote: the effect of the Rule 13e-3 transaction on the affiliate's interest in the net book value and net earnings of the subject company in terms of both dollar amounts and percentages.

statement: The statement must say whether the subject company or affiliate filing it reasonably believes the transaction is fair or unfair to unaffiliated security holders.
quote: State whether the subject company or affiliate filing the statement reasonably believes that the Rule 13e-3 transaction is fair or unfair to unaffiliated security holders.
note: The packet prints no RFO counterpart for this section, so the RFO citation is omitted.

statement: If a director dissented to or abstained from voting on the transaction, the statement must identify the director and, if known after reasonable inquiry, indicate the reasons for the dissent or abstention.
quote: If any director dissented to or abstained from voting on the Rule 13e-3 transaction, identify the director, and indicate, if known, after making reasonable inquiry, the reasons for the dissent or abstention.

statement: The statement must discuss in reasonable detail the material factors on which the fairness belief is based and, to the extent practicable, the weight assigned to each factor.
quote: Discuss in reasonable detail the material factors upon which the belief stated in paragraph (a) of this section is based and, to the extent practicable, the weight assigned to each factor.

statement: That discussion must analyse the extent, if any, to which the filing person's beliefs are based on the factors in the factors instruction, on the holder-approval, representative and director-approval paragraphs, and on the reports and opinions item.
quote: The discussion must include an analysis of the extent, if any, to which the filing person's beliefs are based on the factors described in Instruction 2 of this section, paragraphs (c), (d) and (e) of this section and Item 1015 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1015).

statement: The statement must say whether the transaction is structured so that approval of at least a majority of unaffiliated security holders is required.
quote: State whether or not the transaction is structured so that approval of at least a majority of unaffiliated security holders is required.

statement: The statement must say whether a majority of the directors who are not employees of the subject company has retained an unaffiliated representative to act solely on behalf of unaffiliated security holders for purposes of negotiating the terms of the transaction; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0415.
quote: State whether or not a majority of directors who are not employees of the subject company has retained an unaffiliated representative to act solely on behalf of unaffiliated security holders for purposes of negotiating the terms of the Rule 13e-3 transaction

statement: Preparing a report concerning the fairness of the transaction is the other purpose for which that representative may be retained, alone or together with negotiating the terms; this fragment completes the sentence in CL-MNA-0414.
quote: and/or preparing a report concerning the fairness of the transaction.

statement: The statement must say whether the transaction was approved by a majority of the directors of the subject company who are not employees of the subject company.
quote: State whether or not the Rule 13e-3 transaction was approved by a majority of the directors of the subject company who are not employees of the subject company.

statement: If an offer of the type described in paragraph (viii) of the factors instruction has been received, the statement must describe the offer and state the reasons for its rejection; CL-MNA-0422 and CL-MNA-0423 quote that paragraph.
quote: If any offer of the type described in paragraph (viii) of Instruction 2 to this section has been received, describe the offer and state the reasons for its rejection.

statement: A statement that the issuer or affiliate has no reasonable belief as to the fairness of the transaction to unaffiliated security holders is not sufficient disclosure for the fairness paragraph.
quote: A statement that the issuer or affiliate has no reasonable belief as to the fairness of the Rule 13e-3 transaction to unaffiliated security holders will not be considered sufficient disclosure in response to paragraph (a) of this section.

statement: Normally the factors include those in the holder-approval, representative and director-approval paragraphs and whether the consideration offered to unaffiliated holders is fair value in relation to the measures the instruction then lists; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0420.
quote: Normally such factors will include, among others, those referred to in paragraphs (c), (d) and (e) of this section and whether the consideration offered to unaffiliated security holders constitutes fair value in relation to:

statement: Those measures are current market prices, historical market prices, net book value, going concern value and liquidation value.
quote: (i) Current market prices; (ii) Historical market prices; (iii) Net book value; (iv) Going concern value; (v) Liquidation value;

statement: The factors normally also include purchase prices paid in previous purchases disclosed in response to the prior-purchases item, and any report, opinion or appraisal described under the reports and opinions item; the list continues in CL-MNA-0422.
quote: (vi) Purchase prices paid in previous purchases disclosed in response to Item 1002(f) of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1002(f)); (vii) Any report, opinion, or appraisal described in Item 1015 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1015); and

statement: They also include firm offers made by an unaffiliated person other than the filing persons, of which the subject company or affiliate is aware, made during the past two years, where the offer is for a merger or consolidation of the subject company with or into another company, or vice versa; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0423.
quote: Firm offers of which the subject company or affiliate is aware made by any unaffiliated person, other than the filing persons, during the past two years for: (A) The merger or consolidation of the subject company with or into another company, or vice versa;

statement: The listed firm offers also cover the sale or other transfer of all or any substantial part of the assets of the subject company, and a purchase of its securities that would enable the holder to exercise control; this fragment completes the sentence in CL-MNA-0422.
quote: (B) The sale or other transfer of all or any substantial part of the assets of the subject company; or (C) A purchase of the subject company's securities that would enable the holder to exercise control of the subject company.

statement: The statement must say whether the subject company or affiliate has received any report, opinion other than an opinion of counsel, or appraisal from an outside party that is materially related to the transaction; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0425.
quote: State whether or not the subject company or affiliate has received any report, opinion (other than an opinion of counsel) or appraisal from an outside party that is materially related to the Rule 13e-3 transaction
note: The packet prints no RFO counterpart for this section, so the RFO citation is omitted.

statement: The disclosure reaches, but is not limited to, any report, opinion or appraisal relating to the consideration, the fairness of the consideration to be offered to security holders, or the fairness of the transaction to the issuer or affiliate or to security holders who are not affiliates.
quote: including, but not limited to: Any report, opinion or appraisal relating to the consideration or the fairness of the consideration to be offered to security holders or the fairness of the transaction to the issuer or affiliate or to security holders who are not affiliates.

statement: For each report, opinion or appraisal described in response to the first paragraph, and for any negotiation or report concerning the terms of the transaction that is described in response to the unaffiliated-representative paragraph of the fairness item or to the cited item of the proxy schedule, the filing must give the detail that follows; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0427.
quote: For each report, opinion or appraisal described in response to paragraph (a) of this section or any negotiation or report described in response to Item 1014(d) of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1014) or Item 14(b)(6) of Schedule 14A (§ 240.14a-101 of this chapter) concerning the terms of the transaction:

statement: The filing must identify the outside party or unaffiliated representative, briefly describe that party's qualifications, and describe the method of selection of that party.
quote: (1) Identify the outside party and/or unaffiliated representative; (2) Briefly describe the qualifications of the outside party and/or unaffiliated representative; (3) Describe the method of selection of the outside party and/or unaffiliated representative;

statement: The filing must describe any material relationship that existed during the past two years or is mutually understood to be contemplated, and any compensation received or to be received as a result of that relationship, between the parties the item then names; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0429.
quote: (4) Describe any material relationship that existed during the past two years or is mutually understood to be contemplated and any compensation received or to be received as a result of the relationship between:

statement: The parties are the outside party, its affiliates or the unaffiliated representative on one side, and the subject company or its affiliates on the other; this fragment completes the sentence in CL-MNA-0428.
quote: (i) The outside party, its affiliates, and/or unaffiliated representative; and (ii) The subject company or its affiliates;

statement: Where the report, opinion or appraisal relates to the fairness of the consideration, the filing must state whether the subject company or affiliate determined the amount of consideration to be paid or whether the outside party recommended it.
quote: (5) If the report, opinion or appraisal relates to the fairness of the consideration, state whether the subject company or affiliate determined the amount of consideration to be paid or whether the outside party recommended the amount of consideration to be paid;

statement: The filing must furnish a summary concerning the negotiation, report, opinion or appraisal, and the summary must include, but need not be limited to, the procedures followed and the findings and recommendations; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0432.
quote: Furnish a summary concerning the negotiation, report, opinion or appraisal. The summary must include, but need not be limited to, the procedures followed; the findings and recommendations;

statement: The summary must also include the bases for and methods of arriving at the findings and recommendations, the instructions received from the subject company or affiliate, and any limitation that company or affiliate imposed on the scope of the investigation; this fragment completes the sentence in CL-MNA-0431.
quote: the bases for and methods of arriving at such findings and recommendations; instructions received from the subject company or affiliate; and any limitation imposed by the subject company or affiliate on the scope of the investigation.

statement: The information required by the identity, qualifications and selection subparagraphs must be given for the firm that provides the report, opinion or appraisal rather than for the employees of the firm that prepared it; those subparagraphs are quoted in CL-MNA-0427.
quote: The information called for by paragraphs (b)(1), (2) and (3) of this section must be given with respect to the firm that provides the report, opinion or appraisal rather than the employees of the firm that prepared the report.

statement: The filing must furnish a statement to the effect that the report, opinion or appraisal will be made available for inspection and copying at the principal executive offices of the subject company or affiliate during its regular business hours; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0435.
quote: Furnish a statement to the effect that the report, opinion or appraisal will be made available for inspection and copying at the principal executive offices of the subject company or affiliate during its regular business hours

statement: Availability runs to any interested equity security holder of the subject company or to a representative who has been designated in writing; this fragment completes the sentence in CL-MNA-0434.
quote: by any interested equity security holder of the subject company or representative who has been so designated in writing.

statement: The schedule must carry as exhibits any disclosure materials furnished to security holders by or on behalf of the filing person, including the categories the item then lists; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0437.
quote: File as an exhibit to the schedule: (a) Any disclosure materials furnished to security holders by or on behalf of the filing person, including:
note: The packet prints no RFO counterpart for this section, so the RFO citation is omitted.

statement: The listed disclosure materials include tender offer materials, including the transmittal letter, and the solicitation or recommendation.
quote: (1) Tender offer materials (including transmittal letter); (2) Solicitation or recommendation (including those referred to in Item 1012 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1012));

statement: They also include the going-private disclosure document, a prospectus used in connection with an exchange offer where securities are registered under the Securities Act of 1933, and any other disclosure materials.
quote: (3) Going-private disclosure document; (4) Prospectus used in connection with an exchange offer where securities are registered under the Securities Act of 1933; and (5) Any other disclosure materials;

statement: The exhibits must include any loan agreement referred to in response to the schedule item that the subparagraph cites.
quote: (b) Any loan agreement referred to in response to Item 1007(d) of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1007(d));
