quote: If the filing relates to a third-party tender offer and a request is made under Item 1007(d) of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1007(d)), the identity of the bank providing financing may be omitted from the loan agreement filed as an exhibit.

statement: The exhibits must include any report, opinion or appraisal referred to in response to the fairness representative paragraph or the reports and opinions item.
quote: (c) Any report, opinion or appraisal referred to in response to Item 1014(d) or Item 1015 of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1014(d) or § 229.1015);

statement: The exhibits must include any document setting forth the terms of any agreement, arrangement, understanding or relationship referred to in response to the two schedule items that the subparagraph cites.
quote: (d) Any document setting forth the terms of any agreement, arrangement, understanding or relationship referred to in response to Item 1005(e) or Item 1011(a)(1) of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1005(e) or § 229.1011(a)(1));

statement: The exhibits must include any agreement, arrangement or understanding referred to in response to the schedule item that the subparagraph cites, or the pertinent portions of any proxy statement, report or other communication containing the disclosure that item requires.
quote: (e) Any agreement, arrangement or understanding referred to in response to § 229.1005(d), or the pertinent portions of any proxy statement, report or other communication containing the disclosure required by Item 1005(d) of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1005(d));

statement: The exhibits must include a detailed statement describing security holders' appraisal rights and the procedures for exercising those rights.
quote: (f) A detailed statement describing security holders' appraisal rights and the procedures for exercising those appraisal rights referred to in response to Item 1004(d) of Regulation M-A (§ 229.1004(d));

statement: The exhibits must include any written instruction, form or other material furnished to persons making an oral solicitation or recommendation by or on behalf of the filing person for their use directly or indirectly in connection with the transaction; the list continues in CL-MNA-0446.
quote: (g) Any written instruction, form or other material that is furnished to persons making an oral solicitation or recommendation by or on behalf of the filing person for their use directly or indirectly in connection with the transaction; and

statement: The exhibits must include any written opinion prepared by legal counsel at the filing person's request and communicated to the filing person on the tax consequences of the transaction.
quote: (h) Any written opinion prepared by legal counsel at the filing person's request and communicated to the filing person pertaining to the tax consequences of the transaction.

statement: Schedules or similar attachments to the required exhibits need not be filed where they do not contain information material to an investment or voting decision and that information is not otherwise disclosed in the exhibit or the disclosure document.
quote: Schedules (or similar attachments) to the exhibits required by this Item are not required to be filed provided that they do not contain information material to an investment or voting decision and that information is not otherwise disclosed in the exhibit or the disclosure document.

statement: The registrant may redact information from required exhibits where disclosure of it would be a clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy, such as bank account numbers, social security numbers or home addresses.
quote: The registrant may redact information from exhibits required to be filed by this Item if disclosure of such information would constitute a clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy (e.g., disclosure of bank account numbers, social security numbers, home addresses and similar information).

statement: A conclusory statement of fairness, such as the instruction's example that the transaction is fair in relation to net book value, going concern value and future prospects of the issuer, is not sufficient disclosure for the factors discussion.
quote: Conclusory statements, such as “The Rule 13e-3 transaction is fair to unaffiliated security holders in relation to net book value, going concern value and future prospects of the issuer” will not be considered sufficient disclosure in response to paragraph (b) of this section.

statement: If the contractor received its contract under subpart 8.7 of the FAR, Committee for Purchase from People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled, the procedures at 8.716 are used instead of the written request to the responsible contracting officer.
quote: If the contractor received its contract under subpart 8.7 under 41 U.S.C. chapter 85, Committee for Purchase from People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled, use the procedures at 8.716 instead.

quote: (1) The comments received from the affected contract administration offices and contracting offices;

quote: They do not include restructuring activities occurring after a business combination that affect the operations of only one of the companies not previously under common ownership or control, or, when there has been no business combination, restructuring activities undertaken within one company.

quote: instead, the normal rules for determining cost allowability in accordance with FAR part 31 shall apply.

quote: Restructuring costs that are allowable under Part 31 of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) or Part 231 of the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) may be reimbursed under flexibily-priced novated contracts

quote: If such a date is not readily determinable, or if its use can result in an inequitable calculation, the contracting parties shall agree on an appropriate date.

statement: Plan improvements mandated by law or collective bargaining agreement are not subject to the prorata phase-in.

quote: The numerator of such fraction shall be the sum of the pension plan costs allocated to all contracts and subcontracts (including Foreign Military Sales) subject to this Standard during a period of years representative of the Government's participation in the pension plan.

quote: The denominator of such fraction shall be the total pension costs assigned to cost accounting periods during those same years.

quote: (b) Recognition of a change in a contractor's name; and (c) Execution of novation agreements and change-of-name agreements by the responsible contracting officer.

statement: Concerns and entities are affiliates of each other when one controls or has the power to control the other, or a third party or parties controls or has the power to control both, whether or not control is exercised.
quote: Concerns and entities are affiliates of each other when one controls or has the power to control the other, or a third party or parties controls or has the power to control both. It does not matter whether control is exercised, so long as the power to control exists.

statement: Negative control includes, but is not limited to, instances where a minority shareholder can, under the concern's charter, by-laws or shareholder's agreement, prevent a quorum or otherwise block action by the board of directors or shareholders.
quote: Negative control includes, but is not limited to, instances where a minority shareholder has the ability, under the concern's charter, by-laws, or shareholder's agreement, to prevent a quorum or otherwise block action by the board of directors or shareholders.

statement: SBA will not find that a minority shareholder has negative control where the shareholder has the authority to block action by the board of directors or shareholders regarding the extraordinary circumstances that the rule then lists.
quote: However, SBA will not find that a minority shareholder has negative control where such minority shareholder has the authority to block action by the board of directors or shareholders regarding the following extraordinary circumstances:

statement: The listed extraordinary circumstances include adding a new equity stakeholder or increasing an equity stakeholder's investment, dissolution of the company, sale of the company or all of its assets, and the merger of the company.
quote: (i) Adding a new equity stakeholder or increasing the investment amount of an equity stakeholder; (ii) Dissolution of the company; (iii) Sale of the company or all assets of the company; (iv) The merger of the company;
note: The list continues with bankruptcy, amendment of governance documents to remove the blocking authority, and other extraordinary actions crafted solely to protect minority investment.

statement: In determining whether affiliation exists, SBA considers the totality of the circumstances and may find affiliation even though no single factor is sufficient to constitute affiliation.
quote: In determining whether affiliation exists, SBA will consider the totality of the circumstances, and may find affiliation even though no single factor is sufficient to constitute affiliation.

statement: In determining the size of the concern at issue, SBA counts the receipts, employees or other measure of size of that concern and of all its domestic and foreign affiliates, whether or not the affiliates are organized for profit.
quote: In determining the concern's size, SBA counts the receipts, employees, or other measure of size of the concern whose size is at issue and all of its domestic and foreign affiliates, regardless of whether the affiliates are organized for profit.

statement: A person that owns, or has the power to control, 50 percent or more of a concern's voting stock, or a block of voting stock that is large compared to other outstanding blocks, controls or has the power to control the concern.
quote: A person (including any individual, concern or other entity) that owns, or has the power to control, 50 percent or more of a concern's voting stock, or a block of voting stock which is large compared to other outstanding blocks of voting stock, controls or has the power to control the concern.

statement: SBA presumes that each such person controls or has the power to control the concern whose size is at issue where the minority holdings are equal or approximately equal in size and their aggregate is large as compared with any other stock holding.
quote: such minority holdings are equal or approximately equal in size, and the aggregate of these minority holdings is large as compared with any other stock holding, SBA presumes that each such person controls or has the power to control the concern whose size is at issue.

statement: The presumption that each such person controls the concern whose size is at issue may be rebutted by a showing that such control or power to control does not in fact exist.
quote: SBA presumes that each such person controls or has the power to control the concern whose size is at issue. This presumption may be rebutted by a showing that such control or power to control does not in fact exist.

statement: If a concern's voting stock is widely held and no single block is large compared with all other stock holdings, the concern's Board of Directors and CEO or President are deemed to have the power to control the concern in the absence of evidence to the contrary.
quote: If a concern's voting stock is widely held and no single block of stock is large as compared with all other stock holdings, the concern's Board of Directors and CEO or President will be deemed to have the power to control the concern in the absence of evidence to the contrary.

statement: SBA considers stock options, convertible securities and agreements to merge, including agreements in principle, to have a present effect on the power to control a concern, and it treats the rights granted as though they have been exercised.
quote: SBA considers stock options, convertible securities, and agreements to merge (including agreements in principle) to have a present effect on the power to control a concern. SBA treats such options, convertible securities, and agreements as though the rights granted have been exercised.
note: The quote begins after the opening words In determining size.

statement: Agreements to open or continue negotiations towards the possibility of a merger or a sale of stock at some later date are not agreements in principle and are not given present effect.
quote: Agreements to open or continue negotiations towards the possibility of a merger or a sale of stock at some later date are not considered “agreements in principle” and are thus not given present effect.

statement: Items that are subject to conditions precedent which are incapable of fulfillment, speculative, conjectural or unenforceable under state or Federal law, or where the probability of the transaction or of the exercise of the rights occurring is shown to be extremely remote, are not given present effect.
quote: that are subject to conditions precedent which are incapable of fulfillment, speculative, conjectural, or unenforceable under state or Federal law, or where the probability of the transaction (or exercise of the rights) occurring is shown to be extremely remote, are not given present effect.
note: The quote begins mid-sentence; the subject of the sentence is options, convertible securities, and agreements.

statement: SBA will not give present effect to an individual's, concern's or other entity's ability to divest all or part of its ownership interest in order to avoid a finding of affiliation.
quote: SBA will not give present effect to individuals', concerns' or other entities' ability to divest all or part of their ownership interest in order to avoid a finding of affiliation.

statement: Affiliation arises where one or more officers, directors, managing members or partners who control the board of directors or management of one concern also control the board of directors or management of one or more other concerns.
quote: Affiliation arises where one or more officers, directors, managing members, or partners who control the board of directors and/or management of one concern also control the board of directors or management of one or more other concerns.
note: The quote reads and/or; the statement uses or.

statement: Affiliation may arise among two or more persons with an identity of interest.
quote: Affiliation may arise among two or more persons with an identity of interest.

statement: If a concern has acquired an affiliate or been acquired as an affiliate during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the annual receipts used in determining size status include the receipts of the acquired or acquiring concern.
quote: If a concern has acquired an affiliate or been acquired as an affiliate during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the annual receipts used in determining size status includes the receipts of the acquired or acquiring concern.

statement: Where the annual receipts used in determining size status include the receipts of an acquired or acquiring concern, that aggregation applies for the entire period of measurement, not just the period after the affiliation arose.
quote: the annual receipts used in determining size status includes the receipts of the acquired or acquiring concern. This aggregation applies for the entire period of measurement, not just the period after the affiliation arose.

statement: Where a concern has acquired a segregable division of another business concern during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the annual receipts used in determining size status do not include the receipts of the acquired division prior to the acquisition.
quote: has acquired a segregable division of another business concern during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the annual receipts used in determining size status do not include the receipts of the acquired division prior to the acquisition.
note: The quote begins after the words However, if a concern.

statement: The annual receipts of a former affiliate are not included if affiliation ceased before the date used for determining size, and that exclusion applies during the entire period of measurement rather than only for the period after affiliation ceased.
quote: The annual receipts of a former affiliate are not included if affiliation ceased before the date used for determining size. This exclusion of annual receipts of such former affiliate applies during the entire period of measurement, rather than only for the period after which affiliation ceased.

statement: If a concern has sold a segregable division to another business concern during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the annual receipts used in determining size status continue to include the receipts of the division that was sold.
quote: if a concern has sold a segregable division to another business concern during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the annual receipts used in determining size status will continue to include the receipts of the division that was sold.
note: The quote begins after the word However.

statement: If a concern has acquired an affiliate or been acquired as an affiliate during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the employees counted in determining size status include the employees of the acquired or acquiring concern.
quote: If a concern has acquired an affiliate or been acquired as an affiliate during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the employees counted in determining size status include the employees of the acquired or acquiring concern.

statement: Where the employees counted in determining size status include the employees of an acquired or acquiring concern, that aggregation applies for the entire period of measurement, not just the period after the affiliation arose.
quote: the employees counted in determining size status include the employees of the acquired or acquiring concern. Furthermore, this aggregation applies for the entire period of measurement, not just the period after the affiliation arose.

statement: The employees of a former affiliate are not counted if affiliation ceased before the date used for determining size, and that exclusion applies during the entire period of measurement rather than only for the period after affiliation ceased.
quote: The employees of a former affiliate are not counted if affiliation ceased before the date used for determining size. This exclusion of employees of a former affiliate applies during the entire period of measurement, rather than only for the period after which affiliation ceased.

statement: If a concern has sold a segregable division to another business concern during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the employees used in determining size status continue to include the employees of the division that was sold.
quote: However, if a concern has sold a segregable division to another business concern during the applicable period of measurement or before the date on which it self-certified as small, the employees used in determining size status will continue to include the employees of the division that was sold.
note: The quote begins after the word However.

statement: To be determined responsible, a prospective contractor must have adequate financial resources to perform the contract, or the ability to obtain them.

quote: Acceptable evidence normally consists of a commitment or explicit arrangement, that will be in existence at the time of contract award, to rent, purchase, or otherwise acquire the needed facilities, equipment, other resources, or personnel.

statement: The provision applies at any time after a mitigation agreement or condition is entered into or imposed under section 721(l); the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0044.

statement: A Committee member, or the member's designee at or above the Under Secretary or equivalent level, may, subject to paragraph (c)(2) of the section, file an agency notice to the Committee through the Staff Chairperson regarding a transaction if a listed condition is met; the quoted sentence is incomplete here, paragraph (c)(1) lists two alternative conditions, and the second, in paragraph (c)(1)(ii), is the one to which the finality bar is subject and begins in CL-MNA-0578.
quote: (c) With respect to any transaction: (1) Any member of the Committee, or his or her designee at or above the Under Secretary or equivalent level, may, subject to paragraph (c)(2) of this section, file an agency notice to the Committee through the Staff Chairperson regarding a transaction if:

statement: The paragraph (c)(1)(ii) condition requires that the transaction be a covered transaction and that, as one way to meet condition (A), the Committee has informed the parties in writing that it has concluded all action under section 721 or determined that the transaction is not a covered transaction; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0579.
quote: (ii) The transaction is a covered transaction and: (A) The Committee has informed the parties to such transaction in writing that the Committee has concluded all action under section 721 with respect to such transaction or determined that such transaction is not a covered transaction,

statement: Condition (A) is also met where the President has announced a decision not to exercise the President's authority under section 721(d) with respect to the transaction, and condition (B) must also be met by either of two events quoted in CL-MNA-0580 and CL-MNA-0581; the quoted words continue the sentence begun in CL-MNA-0578.
quote: or the President has announced a decision not to exercise the President's authority under section 721(d) with respect to such transaction; and (B) Either:

statement: The first event that meets condition (B) is that a party to the transaction submitted false or misleading material information to the Committee in connection with its consideration of the transaction, or omitted material information, including material documents, from information submitted to the Committee; the quoted words end with "or", which joins this event to the second event in CL-MNA-0581.
quote: (1) A party to such transaction submitted false or misleading material information to the Committee in connection with the Committee's consideration of such transaction or omitted material information, including material documents, from information submitted to the Committee; or

statement: The second event that meets condition (B) is that a party to the transaction, or the entity resulting from its consummation, materially breaches (or, where the review or investigation was initiated under section 721 before August 13, 2018, intentionally materially breaches) a mitigation agreement or condition; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0582.
quote: (2) A party to or the entity resulting from consummation of such transaction materially breaches (or, if the review or investigation of such transaction was initiated under section 721 before August 13, 2018, intentionally materially breaches)

statement: For the second event the agreement or condition is one described in section 721(l)(3)(A), and the breach must be certified to the Committee as a material breach by the lead department or agency monitoring and enforcing the agreement or condition; the quoted words are incomplete here, and the sentence continues in CL-MNA-0583.
quote: a mitigation agreement or condition described in section 721(l)(3)(A), such breach is certified to the Committee by the lead department or agency monitoring and enforcing such agreement or condition as a material breach

statement: Where the review or investigation was initiated under section 721 before August 13, 2018, the certification must be of an intentional material breach, and the Committee must also determine that there are no other adequate and appropriate remedies or enforcement tools available to address the breach; the quoted words complete the sentence begun in CL-MNA-0581.
quote: (or, if the review or investigation of such transaction was initiated under section 721 before August 13, 2018, an intentional material breach), and the Committee determines that there are no other adequate and appropriate remedies or enforcement tools available to address such breach.

statement: Acquiring and acquired persons that the act and the rules require to file notification must do so by completing and filing the Notification and Report Form in accordance with its instructions and the rules.
quote: All acquiring and acquired persons required to file notification by the act and these rules shall do so by completing and filing the Notification and Report Form, in accordance with the instructions thereon and these rules.

statement: The notification must be filed by the preacquisition ultimate parent entity, or by any entity included within the person that the preacquisition ultimate parent entity authorizes to file on its behalf.
quote: The notification required by the act shall be filed by the preacquisition ultimate parent entity, or by any entity included within the person authorized by such preacquisition ultimate parent entity to file notification on its behalf.

statement: Persons that are both acquiring and acquired persons must submit separate forms, one as the acquiring person and one as the acquired person.
quote: Persons that are both acquiring and acquired persons shall submit separate forms, one as the acquiring person and one as the acquired person, following the appropriate instructions for each.

statement: The notification must be certified, and for a partnership any general partner may certify it while for a corporation any officer or director may certify it.
quote: (a) The notification required by the act shall be certified: (1) In the case of a partnership, by any general partner thereof; (2) In the case of a corporation, by any officer or director thereof;

statement: The certifying individual must have actual authority to make the certification on behalf of the person filing notification.
quote: In all cases, the certifying individual must possess actual authority to make the certification on behalf of the person filing notification.

statement: Additional information or documentary material submitted in response to a request under section 7A(e) of the act and section 803.20 must be accompanied by a certification in the format at the end of the Notification and Report Form.
quote: Additional information or documentary material submitted in response to a request pursuant to section 7A(e) and § 803.20 shall be accompanied by a certification in the format appearing at the end of the Notification and Report Form

statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) (CL-MNA-1539), paragraph (c) (CL-MNA-1540; CL-MNA-1541) and paragraph (f) (CL-MNA-1542) of the section, each acquiring person pays the filing fee the act requires to the Federal Trade Commission.
quote: Each acquiring person shall pay the filing fee required by the act to the Federal Trade Commission, except as provided in paragraphs (b), (c), and (f) of this section.

statement: The waiting period begins on the date of receipt of the notification, or of the notification as far as completed with a statement of reasons for noncompliance, from the persons that the paragraph lists next.
quote: shall begin on the date of receipt of the notification required by the act, in the manner provided by these rules (or, if such notification is not completed, the notification to the extent completed and a statement of the reasons for such noncompliance in accordance with § 803.3) from:

statement: One listed source of receipt, for all other acquisitions, is all persons required by the act and the rules to file notification.
quote: (3) In the case of all other acquisitions, all persons required by the act and these rules to file notification.

statement: The waiting period expires on the 30th calendar day after it begins, or the 15th for a cash tender offer or an acquisition covered by 11 USC 363(b), except where section 802.23 applies and provides another day; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0610.
quote: the waiting period shall expire at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on the 30th (or in the case of a cash tender offer or of an acquisition covered by 11 U.S.C. 363(b), the 15th) calendar day (or if § 802.23 applies, such other day as that section may provide) following the beginning of the waiting period

statement: The waiting period is counted from its beginning as determined under paragraph (a) of the section, and the expiry rule applies unless the waiting period is extended under section 7A(e) of the act and section 803.20 or under section 7A(g)(2), or is terminated under section 7A(b)(2) and section 803.11.
quote: as determined under paragraph (a) of this section, unless extended pursuant to Section 7A(e) and § 803.20, or Section 7A(g)(2), or unless terminated pursuant to Section 7A(b)(2) and § 803.11

statement: The Federal Trade Commission and the Assistant Attorney General may in their discretion terminate a waiting period on the written request of any person filing notification or, notwithstanding paragraph (a) of the section (CL-MNA-1543), on their own initiative.
quote: (c) The Federal Trade Commission and the Assistant Attorney General may, in their discretion, terminate a waiting period upon the written request of any person filing notification or, notwithstanding paragraph (a) of this section, sua sponte.

statement: A notification expires one year after the waiting period expired.
quote: Notification with respect to an acquisition shall expire 1 year following the expiration of the waiting period.

statement: A notification covered by the paragraph expires eighteen months after the date of receipt of the person's notification if a request for additional information remains outstanding to that person, and a separate claim states a certification condition; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0614.
quote: shall expire eighteen months following the date of receipt of such person's notification if a request for additional information or documentary material remains outstanding to such person

statement: The eighteen-month expiry applies where the request is outstanding to the person, or to the entities included in it or their officers, directors, partners, agents or employees, without a certification as required by section 803.6(b) on the date in question.
quote: (or entities included therein, officers, directors, partners, agents or employees thereof), without a certification as required by § 803.6(b), on such date.

statement: An acquiring person, and an acquired person in an acquisition to which section 801.30 does not apply, may withdraw its notification by notifying the Federal Trade Commission and the Antitrust Division in writing by email or mail.
quote: An acquiring person, and in the case of an acquisition to which § 801.30 does not apply, an acquired person, may withdraw its notification by notifying the Federal Trade Commission and the Antitrust Division in writing by email or mail of such withdrawal.

statement: A person eligible under the resubmission paragraph may resubmit its notification, starting a new waiting period for the same transaction without an additional filing fee, but only one time and only in the listed circumstances.
quote: may resubmit its notification, thereby initiating a new waiting period for the same transaction without an additional filing fee pursuant to § 803.9(f). This procedure may be used only one time, and only under the following circumstances:

statement: One listed circumstance for resubmission without a new fee is that the resubmitted notification is refiled before the close of the second business day after withdrawal.
quote: (v) The resubmitted notification is refiled prior to the close of the second business day after withdrawal.

statement: A request for additional information that falls within the paragraph extends the waiting period by 30 calendar days from the date of receipt of the requested material, or by 10 calendar days for a cash tender offer or an acquisition covered by 11 USC 363(b).
quote: shall in every instance extend the waiting period for a period of 30 (or, in the case of a cash tender offer or of an acquisition covered by 11 U.S.C. 363(b), 10) calendar days from the date of receipt (as determined under § 803.10) of the additional information or documentary material requested.

statement: A covered investment is a direct or indirect investment by a foreign person other than an excepted investor in an unaffiliated TID U.S. business, proposed or pending on or after a stated date in 2020, that is not a covered control transaction and that affords the foreign person something the paragraph lists next.
quote: means an investment, direct or indirect, by a foreign person other than an excepted investor, in an unaffiliated TID U.S. business that is proposed or pending on or after February 13, 2020, and that: (a) Is not a covered control transaction; and (b) Affords the foreign person:

statement: One listed item is access to material nonpublic technical information of the TID U.S. business, and another listed item is board membership, observer or nomination rights at the TID U.S. business.
quote: (1) Access to any material nonpublic technical information in the possession of the TID U.S. business; (2) Membership or observer rights on, or the right to nominate an individual to a position on, the board of directors or equivalent governing body of the TID U.S. business; or

statement: No investment involving an air carrier that holds a certificate under the cited aviation statute is a covered investment.
quote: (c) Notwithstanding paragraphs (a) and (b) of this section, no investment involving an air carrier, as defined in 49 U.S.C. 40102(a)(2), that holds a certificate issued under 49 U.S.C. 41102 shall be a covered investment.

statement: A covered transaction is any of several listed items, the first two being a covered control transaction and a covered investment.
quote: The term covered transaction means any of the following: (a) A covered control transaction; (b) A covered investment;

statement: A TID U.S. business is any U.S. business that produces, designs, tests, manufactures, fabricates or develops one or more critical technologies, or that meets another listed description.
quote: The term TID U.S. business means any U.S. business that: (a) Produces, designs, tests, manufactures, fabricates, or develops one or more critical technologies;

statement: One listed TID U.S. business description is performing the appendix functions for covered investment critical infrastructure, and another is maintaining or collecting sensitive personal data of U.S. citizens.
quote: (b) Performs the functions as set forth in column 2 of appendix A to this part with respect to covered investment critical infrastructure; or (c) Maintains or collects, directly or indirectly, sensitive personal data of U.S. citizens.

statement: Except as provided in paragraph (d) (CL-MNA-1548), paragraph (e) or paragraph (f) of the section, the parties to a transaction described in the section's two trigger paragraphs must submit a declaration to the Committee.
quote: Except as provided in paragraph (d), (e), or (f) of this section, the parties to a transaction described in paragraph (b) or (c) of this section shall submit to the Committee a declaration with information regarding the transaction in accordance with § 800.403.

statement: A covered transaction that results in a foreign person acquiring a substantial interest in a TID U.S. business, where the governments of a single foreign state other than an excepted foreign state hold a substantial interest in that foreign person, is a mandatory declaration trigger.
quote: a covered transaction that results in the acquisition of a substantial interest in a TID U.S. business by a foreign person in which the national or subnational governments of a single foreign state (other than an excepted foreign state) have a substantial interest.

statement: A mandatory declaration trigger concerns a TID U.S. business that produces, designs, tests, manufactures, fabricates or develops one or more critical technologies for which a U.S. regulatory authorization would be required for the export, reexport, transfer in-country or retransfer of that technology to a person described in the listed items.
quote: a TID U.S. business that produces, designs, tests, manufactures, fabricates, or develops one or more critical technologies for which a U.S. regulatory authorization would be required for the export, reexport, transfer (in-country), or retransfer of such critical technology to a person that:

statement: A voting interest for critical technology mandatory declarations is a direct or indirect voting interest of 25 percent or more, subject to the section's rules for entities run by a general partner and for indirect holdings.
quote: The term voting interest for purposes of critical technology mandatory declarations means, for the purposes of § 800.401(c)(1)(v), a voting interest, direct or indirect, of 25 percent or more, subject to paragraphs (b) and (c) of this section.

statement: Parties must submit the required declaration, or a written notice in its place, no later than the dates that the paragraph lists next.
quote: (g) Parties shall submit to the Committee the declaration required under paragraph (a) of this section, or a written notice under paragraph (f) of this section, no later than:

statement: One listed deadline is thirty days before the completion date of the transaction, if the completion date is after March 14, 2020.
quote: (2) Thirty days before the completion date of the transaction, if the completion date of the transaction is after March 14, 2020.

statement: No declaration is required under the critical-technology trigger for a covered control transaction by an excepted investor.
quote: (e) The submission of a declaration shall not be required under paragraph (c) of this section with respect to: (1) A covered control transaction by an excepted investor;

statement: A person who fails to comply with the mandatory declaration section may be liable to the United States for a civil penalty not to exceed $5,000,000 or the value of the transaction, whichever is greater.
quote: Any person who fails to comply with the requirements of § 800.401 may be liable to the United States for a civil penalty not to exceed $5,000,000 or the value of the transaction, whichever is greater.

statement: Except as otherwise prohibited under section 800.403(e), a party to any proposed or completed transaction may submit a declaration to the Committee instead of a written notice.
quote: Except as otherwise prohibited under § 800.403(e), a party to any proposed or completed transaction may submit to the Committee a declaration regarding the transaction in accordance with the procedures and requirements set forth in §§ 800.403 and 800.404 instead of a written notice.

statement: The 30-day assessment period for a declaration starts on the date the Committee receives the declaration from the Staff Chairperson.
quote: A 30-day period for assessment of a covered transaction that is the subject of a declaration shall commence on the date on which the declaration is received by the Committee from the Staff Chairperson.

statement: The 30-day assessment period for a declaration starts when the Committee receives the declaration from the Staff Chairperson and ends no later than the thirtieth day after it starts, or no later than the next business day if the thirtieth day is not a business day.
quote: shall commence on the date on which the declaration is received by the Committee from the Staff Chairperson. Such period shall end no later than the thirtieth day after it has commenced, or if the thirtieth day is not a business day, no later than the next business day after the thirtieth day.

statement: On receiving a declaration the Committee may, at its discretion, take the actions that the paragraph lists next.
quote: (a) Upon receiving a declaration submitted under § 800.403 with respect to a covered transaction, the Committee may, at the discretion of the Committee:

statement: One listed Committee response is to request that the parties file a written notice, if the Committee has reason to believe the transaction may raise national security considerations.
quote: the Committee may, at the discretion of the Committee: (1) If the Committee has reason to believe that the transaction may raise national security considerations, request that the parties to the transaction file a written notice under subpart E;

statement: One listed Committee response is to initiate a unilateral review of the transaction, and another is to notify the parties in writing that the Committee has concluded all action under section 721.
quote: (3) Initiate a unilateral review of the transaction under § 800.501(c); or (4) Notify the parties in writing that the Committee has concluded all action under section 721 with respect to the transaction.

statement: A 45-day review period starts on the date a voluntary notice has been accepted, an agency notice has been received by the Staff Chairperson, or the Chairperson has requested a notice.
quote: A 45-day period for review of a transaction shall commence on the date on which the voluntary notice has been accepted, agency notice has been received by the Staff Chairperson, or the Chairperson of the Committee has requested a notice under § 800.501(b).

statement: The review ends no later than the forty-fifth day after it commences, or the next business day if the forty-fifth day is not a business day.
quote: Such review shall end no later than the forty-fifth day after it has commenced, or if the forty-fifth day is not a business day, no later than the next business day after the forty-fifth day.

statement: After a review of a notified transaction, the Committee must undertake an investigation of any transaction it has determined to be a covered transaction if one of the listed conditions is met.
quote: (a) After a review of a notified transaction under § 800.503, the Committee shall undertake an investigation of any transaction that it has determined to be a covered transaction if:

statement: One listed condition is that a Committee member other than an ex officio member advises the Staff Chairperson that the member believes the transaction threatens to impair national security and that the threat has not been mitigated; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0643.
quote: (1) A member of the Committee (other than a member designated as ex officio under section 721(k)) advises the Staff Chairperson that the member believes that the transaction threatens to impair the national security of the United States and that the threat has not been mitigated; or

statement: One listed condition is that the lead agency recommends an investigation and the Committee concurs.
quote: (2) The lead agency recommends, and the Committee concurs, that an investigation be undertaken.

statement: After a review of a covered transaction, the Committee must also undertake an investigation to determine the effects on national security of any covered transaction that is a foreign government-controlled transaction; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0645.
quote: (b) The Committee shall also undertake, after a review of a covered transaction under § 800.503, an investigation to determine the effects on national security of any covered transaction that: (1) Is a foreign government-controlled transaction; or

statement: One listed item for the investigation is a covered transaction that would result in foreign-person control of critical infrastructure of or within the United States, if the Committee determines the transaction could impair national security and the impairment has not been mitigated.
quote: (2) Would result in control by a foreign person of critical infrastructure of or within the United States, if the Committee determines that the transaction could impair national security and such impairment has not been mitigated.

statement: The Committee must undertake the investigation described in paragraph (b) of the section unless the Chairperson of the Committee (or the Deputy Secretary of the Treasury) and the head of any lead agency (or that head's deputy-level delegee) make a determination that the remainder of the sentence states.
quote: The Committee shall undertake an investigation as described in paragraph (b) of this section unless the Chairperson of the Committee (or the Deputy Secretary of the Treasury) and the head of any lead agency (or his or her delegee at the deputy level or equivalent)

statement: The determination, made by the Chairperson (or the Deputy Secretary of the Treasury) and the lead-agency head designated by the Chairperson, is that on the basis of the review the covered transaction will not impair the national security of the United States.
quote: (or his or her delegee at the deputy level or equivalent) designated by the Chairperson determine on the basis of the review that the covered transaction will not impair the national security of the United States.

statement: Subject to a paragraph on extension, the Committee must complete an investigation no later than the forty-fifth day after the date it commences, or the next business day if the forty-fifth day is not a business day.
quote: (a) Subject to paragraph (e) of this section, the Committee shall complete an investigation no later than the forty-fifth day after the date the investigation commences, or, if the forty-fifth day is not a business day, no later than the next business day after the forty-fifth day.

statement: On completion or termination of an investigation the Committee must send the President a report requesting the President's decision if a listed condition is met, one being that the Committee recommends that the President suspend or prohibit the transaction.
quote: (b) Upon completion or termination of any investigation, the Committee shall send a report to the President requesting the President's decision if: (1) The Committee recommends that the President suspend or prohibit the transaction;

statement: The extension rule for a request for additional information applies to a request to any person other than the person whose voting securities are acquired in a tender offer (or that person's officers and others) or the acquired person in an acquisition covered by 11 USC 363(b); the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0618.
quote: any person other than either: (i) In the case of a tender offer, the person whose voting securities are being acquired pursuant to the tender offer (or any officer, director, partner, agent or employee thereof), or (ii) In the case of an acquisition covered by 11 U.S.C. 363(b), the acquired person,

statement: If a waiting period would expire on a Saturday, Sunday or legal public holiday, it is extended to the end of the next regular business day, Eastern Time.
quote: (3) If any waiting period would expire on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal public holiday (as defined in 5 U.S.C. 6103(a)) the waiting period shall be extended to 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time of the next regular business day.

statement: If either person's notification expires under the eighteen-month paragraph, both parties must file a new notification in order to carry out the transaction.
quote: If either person's notification expires pursuant to this paragraph, both parties must file a new notification in order to carry out the transaction.

statement: An acquiring person whose notification was voluntarily withdrawn, or is deemed to have been automatically withdrawn, may resubmit its notification.
quote: An acquiring person whose notification has been voluntarily withdrawn pursuant to paragraph (a) of this section, or an acquiring person whose notification is deemed to have been automatically withdrawn under paragraph (b) of this section, may resubmit its notification

statement: One listed circumstance for resubmission without a new fee is that the notification was withdrawn before the waiting period expired or ended early and before a request for additional information issued.
quote: (i) The notification is withdrawn prior to the expiration or early termination of the waiting period and prior to the issuance of a request for additional information pursuant to § 803.20 and section 7A(e) of the act;

statement: A covered control transaction is any transaction proposed or pending after a stated date by or with a foreign person that could result in foreign control of any U.S. business, including one carried out through a joint venture.
quote: The term covered control transaction means any transaction that is proposed or pending after August 23, 1988, by or with any foreign person that could result in foreign control of any U.S. business, including such a transaction carried out through a joint venture.

statement: An excepted investor is a foreign person who is, as of the completion date of the transaction and subject to two later paragraphs of the section, within a list of categories that follows.
quote: The term excepted investor means a foreign person who is, as of the completion date of the transaction and subject to paragraphs (c) and (d) of this section:

statement: Critical technologies means a list of items that begins with defense articles or defense services included on the United States Munitions List.
quote: The term critical technologies means the following: (a) Defense articles or defense services included on the United States Munitions List (USML) set forth in the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130);

statement: A foreign government-controlled transaction is any covered control transaction that could result in control of a U.S. business by a foreign government or a person controlled by or acting on behalf of a foreign government.
quote: The term foreign government-controlled transaction means any covered control transaction that could result in control of a U.S. business by a foreign government or a person controlled by or acting on behalf of a foreign government.

statement: In the context of an acquisition of an interest in a U.S. business by a foreign person, a substantial interest is a direct or indirect voting interest of 25 percent or more; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0660.
quote: The term substantial interest means, in the context of an acquisition of an interest in a U.S. business by a foreign person, a voting interest, direct or indirect, of 25 percent or more,

statement: In the context of a foreign person in which the governments of a single foreign state have an interest, a substantial interest is a direct or indirect voting interest of 49 percent or more, subject to paragraph (b) of the section.
quote: and, in the context of a foreign person in which the national or subnational governments of a single foreign state have an interest, subject to paragraph (b) of this section, a voting interest, direct or indirect, of 49 percent or more.

statement: Critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered control transaction, systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, so vital to the United States that their incapacity or destruction would have a debilitating impact on national security.
quote: The term critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered control transaction, systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, so vital to the United States that the incapacity or destruction of such systems or assets would have a debilitating impact on national security.

statement: Covered investment critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered investment, the systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, set forth in column 1 of appendix A to the part.
quote: The term covered investment critical infrastructure means, in the context of a particular covered investment, the systems and assets, whether physical or virtual, set forth in column 1 of appendix A to this part.

statement: Two listed persons for the critical-technology trigger are a person that could directly control the TID U.S. business as a result of the covered transaction and a person directly acquiring an interest that is a covered investment in it.
quote: (i) Could directly control such TID U.S. business as a result of the covered transaction; (ii) Is directly acquiring an interest that is a covered investment in such TID U.S. business;

statement: Parties to a covered transaction may elect to submit a written notice instead of a declaration.
quote: (f) Notwithstanding paragraph (a) of this section, parties to a covered transaction may elect to submit a written notice under subpart E of this part regarding the transaction instead of a declaration.

statement: The Committee must take action on a declaration within the time period that section 800.405(b) sets.
quote: (b) The Committee shall take action under paragraph (a) of this section within the time period set forth in § 800.405(b).

statement: In extraordinary circumstances the Chairperson may, on a written request signed by the head of a lead agency, extend an investigation for one 15-day period.
quote: (e) In extraordinary circumstances, the Chairperson may, upon a written request signed by the head of a lead agency, extend an investigation for one 15-day period.

statement: An investigation that is to be undertaken commences no later than the end of the review period.
quote: If it is determined that an investigation should be undertaken, such investigation shall commence no later than the end of the review period described in § 800.503.

statement: For the second mandatory-declaration trigger, the assessment of what constitutes a critical technology is made as of the first date on which one of the listed conditions is met with respect to a covered transaction.
quote: (3) For purposes of paragraph (c)(1) of this section, the assessment of what constitutes a critical technology shall be as of the first date on which one of the conditions set forth in § 800.104(b)(1) through (4) is met with respect to a covered transaction.

statement: An acquiring person's notification, and an acquired person's notification in an acquisition to which section 801.30 does not apply, expires eighteen months after the date of receipt of that person's notification in the circumstances the paragraph describes; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0613 and CL-MNA-0614.
quote: An acquiring person's notification and, in the case of an acquisition to which § 801.30 does not apply, an acquired person's notification, shall expire eighteen months following the date of receipt of such person's notification

statement: Financial statements of an acquired business that must be filed under this section, other than the related schedules, must be prepared and audited in accordance with Regulation S-X, including the applicable independence standards; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0671.
quote: Financial statements (except the related schedules specified in § 210.12) prepared and audited in accordance with Regulation S-X (including the independence standards in § 210.2-01 or, alternatively if the business is not a registrant, the applicable independence standards) must be filed

statement: Financial statements of an acquired business must be filed for the periods set by the periods paragraph if any listed condition exists, and one listed condition is that a business acquisition occurred during the most recent fiscal year or subsequent interim period for which a balance sheet is required.
quote: must be filed for the periods specified in paragraph (b) of this section if any of the following conditions exist: (i) During the most recent fiscal year or subsequent interim period for which a balance sheet is required by § 210.3-01, a business acquisition has occurred;

statement: One listed condition is that, after the date of the most recent balance sheet filed, consummation of a business acquisition has occurred or is probable.
quote: (ii) After the date of the most recent balance sheet filed pursuant to § 210.3-01, consummation of a business acquisition has occurred or is probable.

statement: The section on acquired-business statements does not apply to a real estate operation subject to its own separate section or to a business that the registrant totally held before the transaction was consummated.
quote: This section does not apply to a real estate operation subject to § 210.3-14 or a business which is totally held by the registrant prior to consummation of the transaction.

statement: In all cases not specified in the rule for registering an offering to the target's security holders, statements of the acquired business must be filed for the periods set by the significance paragraph or for such shorter period as the business has been in existence.
quote: In all cases not specified in paragraph (b)(1) of this section, financial statements of the business acquired or to be acquired must be filed for the periods specified in this paragraph (b)(2) or such shorter period as the business has been in existence.

statement: The periods for which the acquired business's statements are to be filed are determined using the conditions in the significant subsidiary definition, with the lower of the total revenue component or the income or loss from continuing operations component used for the income test condition.
quote: such financial statements are to be filed using the conditions specified in the definition of significant subsidiary in § 210.1-02(w), using the lower of the total revenue component or income or loss from continuing operations component for evaluating the income test condition, as follows:
note: The printed text does not set out the individual tests inside the significant subsidiary definition.

statement: One listed significance band is that financial statements are not required if none of the conditions exceeds 20 percent.
quote: (i) If none of the conditions exceeds 20 percent, financial statements are not required.

statement: One listed significance band is that, if any condition exceeds 20 percent but none exceeds 40 percent, statements must be filed for at least the most recent fiscal year and the most recent interim period.
quote: (ii) If any of the conditions exceeds 20 percent, but none exceed 40 percent, financial statements must be filed for at least the most recent fiscal year and the most recent interim period specified in §§ 210.3-01 and 210.3-02.

statement: One listed significance band is that, if any condition exceeds 40 percent, statements must be filed for at least the two most recent fiscal years and any interim periods.
quote: (iii) If any of the conditions exceeds 40 percent, financial statements must be filed for at least the two most recent fiscal years and any interim periods specified in §§ 210.3-01 and 210.3-02.

statement: If the registrant registers an offering of securities to the security holders of the business to be acquired, the statements specified in the general annual and interim rules must be filed for that business, except as provided otherwise for filings on the named forms.
quote: If registering an offering of securities to the security holders of the business to be acquired, then the financial statements specified in §§ 210.3-01 and 210.3-02 must be filed for the business to be acquired, except as provided otherwise for filings on Form N-14, S-4, or F-4

statement: Separate statements of the acquired business at the middle significance band need not be presented once its operating results have been reflected in the registrant's audited consolidated statements for at least nine months.
quote: Separate financial statements of the acquired business specified in paragraph (b)(2)(ii) of this section need not be presented once the operating results of the acquired business have been reflected in the audited consolidated financial statements of the registrant for at least nine months.

statement: Separate statements of the acquired business at the highest significance band need not be presented once its operating results have been reflected in the registrant's audited consolidated statements for a complete fiscal year.
quote: Separate financial statements of the acquired business specified in paragraph (b)(2)(iii) of this section need not be presented once the operating results of the acquired business have been reflected in the audited consolidated financial statements of the registrant for a complete fiscal year.

statement: Pro forma financial information must be filed when any of the listed conditions exists.
quote: Pro forma financial information must be filed when any of the following conditions exist:

statement: One listed condition is that a significant business acquisition has occurred during the most recent fiscal year or subsequent interim period for which a balance sheet is required, which includes the acquisition of an interest in a business accounted for by the equity method.
quote: (1) During the most recent fiscal year or subsequent interim period for which a balance sheet is required by § 210.3-01, a significant business acquisition has occurred (for purposes of this section, this encompasses the acquisition of an interest in a business accounted for by the equity method);

statement: One listed condition is that, after the date of the most recent balance sheet filed, consummation of a significant business acquisition or a combination of entities under common control has occurred or is probable.
quote: (2) After the date of the most recent balance sheet filed pursuant to § 210.3-01, consummation of a significant business acquisition or a combination of entities under common control has occurred or is probable;

statement: One listed condition is that securities being registered are to be offered to the security holders of a significant business to be acquired, or that the proceeds will be applied directly or indirectly to the purchase of a specific significant business.
quote: (3) Securities being registered by the registrant are to be offered to the security holders of a significant business to be acquired or the proceeds from the offered securities will be applied directly or indirectly to the purchase of a specific significant business;

statement: One listed condition is that the disposition of a significant portion of a business by sale, abandonment or distribution to shareholders by means of a spin-off, split-up or split-off has occurred or is probable and is not fully reflected in the financial statements of the registrant included in the filing.
quote: disposition of a significant portion of a business either by sale, abandonment or distribution to shareholders by means of a spin-off, split-up or split-off has occurred or is probable and such disposition is not fully reflected in the financial statements of the registrant included in the filing

statement: One listed test of a significant business acquisition is the definition of a significant subsidiary with 20 percent substituted for 10 percent each place it appears.
quote: (b) A business acquisition or disposition will be considered significant if: (1) The business acquisition meets: (i) The definition of a significant subsidiary in § 210.1-02(w)(1), substituting 20 percent for 10 percent each place it appears therein;
note: The printed text does not set out the individual tests inside the significant subsidiary definition.

statement: The pro forma effects of a business acquisition need not be presented if separate statements of the acquired business are not included in the filing, except where the aggregate impact of businesses acquired or to be acquired is significant; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0772.
quote: The pro forma effects of a business acquisition need not be presented pursuant to this section if separate financial statements of the acquired business are not included in the filing, except where the aggregate impact of businesses acquired or to be acquired is significant

statement: Pro forma financial information must consist of a pro forma condensed balance sheet, pro forma condensed statements of comprehensive income and accompanying explanatory notes.
quote: Pro forma financial information must consist of a pro forma condensed balance sheet, pro forma condensed statements of comprehensive income, and accompanying explanatory notes.

statement: Where a limited number of pro forma adjustments are required and they are easily understood, a narrative description of the pro forma effects may be disclosed in place of the condensed statements.
quote: In certain circumstances (i.e., where a limited number of pro forma adjustments are required and those adjustments are easily understood), a narrative description of the pro forma effects of the transaction may be disclosed in lieu of the statements described in this paragraph (a)(1).

statement: The pro forma condensed balance sheet and statements of comprehensive income must include, and be limited to, the listed pro forma adjustments, except as noted in a later paragraph of the same section, and the first listed adjustment is Transaction Accounting Adjustments.
quote: (6) The pro forma condensed balance sheet and pro forma condensed statements of comprehensive income must include, and be limited to, the following pro forma adjustments, except as noted in paragraph (a)(7) of this section: (i) Transaction Accounting Adjustments.

statement: One listed adjustment is Autonomous Entity Adjustments, which depict the registrant as an autonomous entity if the stated condition is met.
quote: (ii) Autonomous Entity Adjustments. Adjustments that depict the registrant as an autonomous entity if the condition in § 210.11-01(a)(7) is met.

statement: Management's Adjustments depicting synergies and dis-synergies of the acquisitions and dispositions may be presented in the registrant's discretion; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0694.
quote: (7) Management's Adjustments depicting synergies and dis-synergies of the acquisitions and dispositions for which pro forma effect is being given may, in the registrant's discretion, be presented

statement: Management's Adjustments may be presented if, in management's opinion, they would enhance an understanding of the pro forma effects of the transaction and the listed conditions are met.
quote: if in its management's opinion, such adjustments would enhance an understanding of the pro forma effects of the transaction and the following conditions are met:

statement: A pro forma condensed balance sheet as of the end of the most recent period for which a consolidated balance sheet is required must be filed unless the transaction is already reflected in that balance sheet.
quote: A pro forma condensed balance sheet as of the end of the most recent period for which a consolidated balance sheet of the registrant is required by § 210.3-01 must be filed unless the transaction is already reflected in such balance sheet.

statement: Pro forma condensed statements of comprehensive income must be filed for only the most recent fiscal year, except as noted in a later paragraph of the same section, and for the period from the most recent fiscal year end to the most recent interim date for which a balance sheet is required.
quote: Pro forma condensed statements of comprehensive income must be filed for only the most recent fiscal year, except as noted in paragraph (c)(2)(ii) of this section, and for the period from the most recent fiscal year end to the most recent interim date for which a balance sheet is required.

statement: Financial statements that are as of a date the specified number of days or more before the expected effective date, or before the proposed mailing date of a proxy statement, shall be updated, except as specified in the following paragraphs.
quote: as of a date the number of days specified in paragraph (g) of this section or more before the date the filing is expected to become effective, or proposed mailing date in the case of a proxy statement, the financial statements shall be updated, except as specified in the following paragraphs

statement: For the update paragraph, the number of days is 130 for large accelerated filers and accelerated filers and 135 for all other registrants.
quote: (g) (1) For purposes of paragraph (a) of this section, the number of days shall be: (i) 130 days for large accelerated filers and accelerated filers (as defined in § 240.12b-2 of this chapter); and (ii) 135 days for all other registrants.

statement: The most recent audited financial statements included in a registration statement under the Securities Act of 1933 or on Form 10 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 shall not be more than one year and 45 days old at the date the registration statement becomes effective, subject to the condition stated in the same paragraph; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0700.
quote: most recent audited financial statements included in a registration statement filed under the Securities Act of 1933 or filed on Form 10 (17 CFR 249.210) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 shall not be more than one year and 45 days old at the date the registration statement becomes effective

statement: The conditional age limit (the one year and 45 days are stated in CL-MNA-0699) applies if the registration statement relates to the security of an issuer that was not subject, immediately before filing, to the reporting requirements of section 13 or 15(d) of the Exchange Act.
quote: if the registration statement relates to the security of an issuer that was not subject, immediately before the time of filing the registration statement, to the reporting requirements of section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.

statement: A foreign private issuer shall state amounts in its primary financial statements in the currency it deems appropriate, while an issuer that is not a foreign private issuer shall present its financial statements in U.S. dollars.
quote: A foreign private issuer, as defined in § 230.405 of this chapter, shall state amounts in its primary financial statements in the currency which it deems appropriate. (2) An issuer that is not a foreign private issuer shall present its financial statements in U.S. dollars.

statement: The issuer shall state its primary financial statements in the same currency for all periods for which financial information is presented.
quote: The issuer shall state its primary financial statements in the same currency for all periods for which financial information is presented.

statement: Interim financial statements shall include a balance sheet as of the end of the issuer's most recent fiscal quarter and a balance sheet as of the end of the preceding fiscal year; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0704.
quote: Interim financial statements shall include a balance sheet as of the end of the issuer's most recent fiscal quarter, a balance sheet as of the end of the preceding fiscal year

statement: The interim financial statements also include statements of comprehensive income and statements of cash flows for the interim period up to the date of the interim balance sheet and the comparable period of the preceding fiscal year.
quote: statements of comprehensive income and statements of cash flows for the interim period up to the date of such balance sheet and the comparable period of the preceding fiscal year.

statement: Interim financial statements may be unaudited, but those included in quarterly reports on Form 10-Q must be reviewed by an independent public accountant before filing.
quote: Interim financial statements may be unaudited; however, before filing, interim financial statements included in quarterly reports on Form 10-Q (§ 249.308(a) of this chapter) must be reviewed by an independent public accountant

statement: If required financial statements are as of a date 135 days or more before a registration statement becomes effective or proxy material is expected to be mailed, they shall be updated to include financial statements for an interim period ending within 135 days.
quote: If required financial statements are as of a date 135 days or more before the date a registration statement becomes effective or proxy material is expected to be mailed, the financial statements shall be updated to include financial statements for an interim period ending within 135 days

statement: A smaller reporting company whose effective or mailing date falls after 45 days but within 90 days of its fiscal year end is not required to provide audited statements for that year end, provided that the listed conditions are met.
quote: the effective date or anticipated mailing date falls after 45 days but within 90 days of the end of the smaller reporting company's fiscal year, the smaller reporting company is not required to provide the audited financial statements for such year end provided that the following conditions are met:

statement: Interim statements required by the interim section need only be provided for the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated and its predecessors, and may be unaudited.
quote: (1) Interim financial statements required by this section need only be provided as to the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated and its predecessors and may be unaudited.

statement: A major interim balance sheet caption may be combined with others where it is less than 10% of total assets and its amount has not increased or decreased by more than 25% since the end of the preceding fiscal year.
quote: Where any major balance sheet caption is less than 10% of total assets, and the amount in the caption has not increased or decreased by more than 25% since the end of the preceding fiscal year, the caption may be combined with others.

statement: For filings on Form 10-Q, financial statements are provided as set forth in the periods paragraph, and one listed item is an interim balance sheet as of the end of the most recent fiscal quarter and a balance sheet as of the end of the preceding fiscal year.
quote: For filings on Form 10-Q, financial statements shall be provided as set forth in this paragraph (c): (1) An interim balance sheet as of the end of the most recent fiscal quarter and a balance sheet as of the end of the preceding fiscal year shall be provided.

statement: One listed item for Form 10-Q is interim statements of comprehensive income for the most recent fiscal quarter, for the period from the end of the preceding fiscal year to the end of the most recent quarter, and for the corresponding periods of the preceding fiscal year.
quote: (2) Interim statements of comprehensive income shall be provided for the most recent fiscal quarter, for the period between the end of the preceding fiscal year and the end of the most recent fiscal quarter, and for the corresponding periods of the preceding fiscal year.

statement: One listed item for Form 10-Q is interim statements of cash flows for the period from the end of the preceding fiscal year to the end of the most recent fiscal quarter and for the corresponding period of the preceding fiscal year.
quote: (3) Interim statements of cash flows shall be provided for the period between the end of the preceding fiscal year and the end of the most recent fiscal quarter, and for the corresponding period of the preceding fiscal year.

statement: Before filing, interim financial statements included in quarterly reports on Form 10-Q must be reviewed by an independent public accountant.
quote: Prior to filing, interim financial statements included in quarterly reports on Form 10-Q (17 CFR 249.308(a)) must be reviewed by an independent public accountant

statement: The accountant's report shall be dated, signed manually, indicate the city and State where issued, and identify without detailed enumeration the financial statements covered.
quote: (a) Technical requirements for accountants' reports. The accountant's report: (1) Shall be dated; (2) Shall be signed manually; (3) Shall indicate the city and State where issued; and (4) Shall identify without detailed enumeration the financial statements covered by the report.

statement: One listed requirement is that the accountant's report shall state the applicable professional standards under which the audit was conducted.
quote: (b) Representations as to the audit included in accountants' reports. The accountant's report: (1) Shall state the applicable professional standards under which the audit was conducted;

statement: The accountant's report shall state clearly the accountant's opinion on the financial statements covered and the accounting principles reflected in them, and the accountant's opinion on the consistency of the application of the accounting principles; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0789.
quote: shall state clearly: (1) The opinion of the accountant in respect of the financial statements covered by the report and the accounting principles and practices reflected therein; and (2) the opinion of the accountant as to the consistency of the application of the accounting principles

statement: Where the retention rule applies, the accountant shall retain records relevant to the audit or review, including workpapers and other documents that form the basis of the audit or review.
quote: the accountant shall retain records relevant to the audit or review, including workpapers and other documents that form the basis of the audit or review

statement: The retention period is seven years after an accountant concludes an audit or review of an issuer's financial statements to which section 10A(a) of the Exchange Act applies; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0790 and CL-MNA-0717.
quote: For a period of seven years after an accountant concludes an audit or review of an issuer's financial statements to which section 10A(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78j-1(a)) applies

statement: The records the accountant must retain also include memoranda, correspondence, communications, other documents and records, including electronic records, that are created, sent or received in connection with the audit or review and contain conclusions, opinions, analyses, or financial data related to it.
quote: memoranda, correspondence, communications, other documents, and records (including electronic records), which: (1) Are created, sent or received in connection with the audit or review, and (2) Contain conclusions, opinions, analyses, or financial data related to the audit or review.
