statement: The regulations define control as power, direct or indirect and whether or not exercised, held through means that include ownership of a majority or a dominant minority of an entity's total outstanding voting interest, board representation, proxy voting, a special share or contractual arrangements.
quote: The term control means the power, direct or indirect, whether or not exercised, through the ownership of a majority or a dominant minority of the total outstanding voting interest in an entity, board representation, proxy voting, a special share, contractual arrangements,

statement: The power that counts as control is power, through the listed or other means, to determine, direct, or decide important matters affecting an entity, in particular and without limitation decisions on the matters the paragraph lists or any other similarly important matters.
quote: or other means, to determine, direct, or decide important matters affecting an entity; in particular, but without limitation, to determine, direct, take, reach, or cause decisions regarding the following matters, or any other similarly important matters affecting an entity:

statement: One listed matter on which power over decisions bears on control is major expenditures or investments, issuances of equity or debt, or dividend payments by the entity, or approval of its operating budget.
quote: (4) Major expenditures or investments, issuances of equity or debt, or dividend payments by the entity, or approval of the operating budget of the entity;

statement: Where more than one foreign person has an ownership interest in an entity, consideration will be given to factors such as whether the foreign persons are related or have formal or informal arrangements to act in concert.
quote: (b) In examining questions of control in situations where more than one foreign person has an ownership interest in an entity, consideration will be given to factors such as whether the foreign persons are related or have formal or informal arrangements to act in concert,

statement: The power to prevent the sale or pledge of all or substantially all of an entity's assets or a voluntary filing for bankruptcy or liquidation is a minority shareholder protection that shall not in itself be deemed to confer control over the entity.
quote: (c) The following minority shareholder protections shall not in themselves be deemed to confer control over an entity: (1) The power to prevent the sale or pledge of all or substantially all of the assets of an entity or a voluntary filing for bankruptcy or liquidation;

statement: One listed minority shareholder protection is the right to purchase an additional interest in an entity to prevent the dilution of an investor's pro rata interest if the entity issues additional instruments conveying interests in it.
quote: (4) The right to purchase an additional interest in an entity to prevent the dilution of an investor's pro rata interest in that entity in the event that the entity issues additional instruments conveying interests in the entity;

statement: The Committee will consider, on a case-by-case basis, whether minority shareholder protections other than those listed in the paragraph on protections that are not themselves control do not confer control over an entity.
quote: (d) The Committee will consider, on a case-by-case basis, whether minority shareholder protections other than those listed in paragraph (c) of this section do not confer control over an entity.

statement: In one listed example, Corporation A acquires seven percent of Corporation B's voting shares and the right to terminate significant contracts of Corporation B, and Corporation A controls Corporation B.
quote: In addition to its acquisition of seven percent of Corporation B's voting shares, Corporation A acquires the right to terminate significant contracts of Corporation B. Corporation A controls Corporation B.

statement: Covered control transactions include a transaction which, irrespective of the actual arrangements for control provided for in its terms, results or could result in control of a U.S. business by a foreign person.
quote: Transactions that are covered control transactions include: (a) A transaction which, irrespective of the actual arrangements for control provided for in the terms of the transaction, results or could result in control of a U.S. business by a foreign person.

statement: One listed covered control transaction is a transaction that results or could result in control by a foreign person of any part of an entity or of assets, if that part of an entity or those assets constitute a U.S. business.
quote: (c) A transaction that results or could result in control by a foreign person of any part of an entity or of assets, if such part of an entity or assets constitutes a U.S. business.

statement: Transactions that are not covered control transactions include a stock split or pro rata stock dividend that does not involve a change in control.
quote: Transactions that are not covered control transactions include: (a) A stock split or pro rata stock dividend that does not involve a change in control.

statement: One listed transaction that is not a covered control transaction is a transaction that results in a foreign person holding 10 percent or less of the outstanding voting interest in a U.S. business, but only if the transaction is solely for the purpose of passive investment.
quote: (b) A transaction that results in a foreign person holding 10 percent or less of the outstanding voting interest in a U.S. business (regardless of the dollar value of the interest so acquired), but only if the transaction is solely for the purpose of passive investment.

statement: In one listed example, Corporation A may choose not to exercise its power to elect new directors for Corporation X but nevertheless will have that exercisable power, and the proposed transaction is a covered control transaction.
quote: Although Corporation A may choose not to exercise its power to elect new directors for Corporation X, Corporation A nevertheless will have that exercisable power. The proposed transaction is a covered control transaction.

statement: In one listed example, a foreign person's purchase of a branch office located entirely outside the United States of a corporation incorporated in the United States is not a covered control transaction, assuming no other relevant facts, because the branch office is not a U.S. business.
quote: buys a branch office located entirely outside the United States of Corporation Y, which is incorporated in the United States. Assuming no other relevant facts, the branch office of Corporation Y is not a U.S. business, and the transaction is not a covered control transaction.

statement: In one listed example, Corporation X would acquire the personnel, customer list, equipment and inventory management software used to operate the facility, and under those facts Corporation X is acquiring a U.S. business and the proposed acquisition is a covered control transaction.
quote: Corporation X would acquire the personnel, customer list, equipment, and inventory management software used to operate the facility. Under these facts, Corporation X is acquiring a U.S. business, and the proposed acquisition is a covered control transaction.

statement: In one listed example, a foreign person's acquisition of voting shares in a U.S. business is not solely for passive investment and is a covered control transaction where the foreign person also negotiates contractual rights that give it the power to control important matters.
quote: Corporation A also negotiates contractual rights that give it the power to control important matters of Corporation X. The acquisition by Corporation A of the voting shares of Corporation X is not solely for the purpose of passive investment and is a covered control transaction.

statement: Covered investments include a transaction that meets the requirements of the covered investment definition irrespective of the percentage of voting interest acquired.
quote: Transactions that are covered investments include: (a) A transaction that meets the requirements of § 800.211 irrespective of the percentage of voting interest acquired.

statement: In one listed example, a proposed transaction with an unaffiliated TID U.S. business is a covered investment where a designee of the foreign person will have the right to observe the meetings of the target's board of directors.
quote: Corporation B is therefore an unaffiliated TID U.S. business. Pursuant to the terms of the investment, a designee of Corporation A will have the right to observe the meetings of the board of directors of Corporation B. The proposed transaction is a covered investment.

statement: Transactions that are not covered investments include an investment by a foreign person in an unaffiliated TID U.S. business that does not afford the foreign person any of the access, rights, or involvement specified in the covered investment definition.
quote: Transactions that are not covered investments include: (a) An investment by a foreign person in an unaffiliated TID U.S. business that does not afford the foreign person any of the access, rights, or involvement specified in § 800.211(b).

statement: One listed transaction that is not a covered investment is an investment by a foreign person who is an excepted investor in an unaffiliated TID U.S. business.
quote: (b) An investment by a foreign person who is an excepted investor in an unaffiliated TID U.S. business.

statement: One listed transaction that is not a covered investment is a transaction that results or could result in control by a foreign person of an unaffiliated TID U.S. business.
quote: (c) A transaction that results or could result in control by a foreign person of an unaffiliated TID U.S. business.

statement: In one listed example, a proposed purchase that makes the purchaser the sole owner of an unaffiliated TID U.S. business, with the right to elect directors and appoint other primary officers, is not a covered investment but is a covered control transaction, assuming no other relevant facts.
quote: As the sole owner, Corporation A will have the right to elect directors and appoint other primary officers of Corporation B. Assuming no other relevant facts, the proposed transaction is not a covered investment. It is, however, a covered control transaction.

statement: If a foreign person that did not acquire control of the U.S. business in the prior transaction is a party to the later transaction, the later transaction may be a covered transaction.
quote: If, however, a foreign person that did not acquire control of the U.S. business in the prior transaction is a party to the later transaction, the later transaction may be a covered transaction.

statement: In one listed example, a later acquisition is not a covered transaction because the Committee concluded all action with respect to Corporation A's earlier direct acquisition of control in the same U.S. business and no other foreign person is a party to the later transaction.
quote: because the Committee concluded all action with respect to Corporation A's earlier direct acquisition of control in the same U.S. business, and because no other foreign person is a party to this subsequent transaction, this subsequent transaction is not a covered transaction.

statement: A loan or similar financing arrangement by a foreign person to a U.S. business, regardless of whether it is accompanied by a secured interest in favor of the foreign person over securities or other assets of the business, shall not, by itself, constitute a covered transaction.
quote: a loan or a similar financing arrangement by a foreign person to a U.S. business, regardless of whether accompanied by the creation in favor of the foreign person of a secured interest over securities or other assets of the U.S. business, shall not, by itself, constitute a covered transaction.

statement: The Committee will accept notices or declarations about a loan or similar financing arrangement that is not by itself a covered transaction only at the time that, because of imminent or actual default or other condition, there is a significant possibility of an outcome that the paragraph goes on to list; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0802.
quote: The Committee will accept notices or declarations concerning a loan or a similar financing arrangement that does not, by itself, constitute a covered transaction only at the time that, because of imminent or actual default or other condition, there is a significant possibility

statement: In one listed example, a loan under which Corporation A has, as a result of the transaction and under the terms of the loan documentation, the power to determine, direct, or decide important matters affecting Corporation B is a covered control transaction.
quote: Also, as a result of the transaction, under the terms of the loan documentation, Corporation A has the power to determine, direct, or decide important matters affecting Corporation B. This loan is a covered control transaction.

statement: An investment by a foreign person in a TID U.S. business through an investment fund that gives the foreign person or its designee membership as a limited partner or equivalent on an advisory board or committee of the fund shall not be considered a covered investment if the listed conditions are met.
quote: investment by a foreign person in a TID U.S. business through an investment fund that affords the foreign person (or a designee of the foreign person) membership as a limited partner or equivalent on an advisory board or a committee of the fund shall not be considered a covered investment if

statement: In extraordinary circumstances the Committee may consider a waiver of a potential conflict of interest, a waiver of an allocation limitation, or a similar activity under an investment fund agreement to constitute control.
quote: In extraordinary circumstances, the Committee may consider the waiver of a potential conflict of interest, the waiver of an allocation limitation, or a similar activity, applicable to a transaction pursuant to the terms of an agreement governing an investment fund, to constitute control

statement: The party or parties submitting a declaration shall provide the information set out in the section on declaration contents, which must be accurate and complete with respect to all parties and to the transaction.
quote: (a) The party or parties submitting a declaration of a transaction under § 800.403 shall provide the information set out in this section, which must be accurate and complete with respect to all parties and to the transaction.

statement: One listed item of information about the transaction is the total transaction value in U.S. dollars.
quote: (v) The total transaction value in U.S. dollars;

statement: Subject to paragraph (e) of the section (CL-MNA-1552), a declaration shall describe or provide, as applicable, the listed items, the first being the names of the foreign persons and U.S. businesses that are parties to or the subject of the transaction; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0068.
quote: Subject to paragraph (e) of this section, a declaration submitted under § 800.403 shall describe or provide, as applicable: (1) The name of the foreign person(s) and U.S. business(es) that are parties to, or, in applicable cases, the subject of, the transaction,

statement: Each party submitting a declaration shall provide a certification of the information contained in the declaration consistent with the certification section.
quote: (d) Each party submitting a declaration shall provide a certification of the information contained in the declaration consistent with § 800.204.

statement: The Committee, acting through the Staff Chairperson, may reject any declaration that does not comply with the section on declaration contents and so inform the parties promptly in writing.
quote: (a) The Committee, acting through the Staff Chairperson, may: (1) Reject any declaration that does not comply with § 800.404 and so inform the parties promptly in writing;

statement: One listed ground for rejecting a declaration at any time after submission is that the submitting party or parties do not provide follow-up information requested by the Staff Chairperson within two business days of the request, subject to a longer time frame that the paragraph describes; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0804.
quote: (3) Reject any declaration at any time after the declaration has been submitted, and so inform the parties promptly in writing, if the party (or parties) that submitted the declaration does not provide follow-up information requested by the Staff Chairperson within two business days of the request,

statement: Parties that have submitted a declaration may request in writing, at any time before the Committee takes action under the section on Committee responses, that the declaration be withdrawn.
quote: (c) Parties to a transaction that have submitted a declaration under § 800.403 may request in writing, at any time prior to the Committee taking action under § 800.407, that such declaration be withdrawn.

statement: Except as otherwise prohibited under paragraph (j) of the section on procedures for notices, a party or parties to a proposed or completed transaction may file a voluntary notice of the transaction with the Committee.
quote: Except as otherwise prohibited under paragraph (j) of this section, a party or parties to a proposed or completed transaction may file a voluntary notice of the transaction with the Committee.

statement: A voluntary notice is filed by sending an electronic copy of the notice that includes, in English, the information the notice-contents section sets out, including the required certification, and by paying the fee required under the filing-fee subpart.
quote: Voluntary notice to the Committee is filed by sending an electronic copy of the notice that includes, in English, the information set out in § 800.502, including the certification required under paragraph (l) of that section, and paying the fee required under subpart K of this part.

statement: The Committee, acting through the Staff Chairperson, may reject any voluntary notice that does not comply with the notice-procedures section or the notice-contents section and so inform the parties promptly in writing.
quote: (a) The Committee, acting through the Staff Chairperson, may: (1) Reject any voluntary notice that does not comply with § 800.501 or § 800.502 and so inform the parties promptly in writing;

statement: One listed ground for rejecting a voluntary notice at any time is that, after submission and before action by the Committee or the President has been concluded, there is a material change in the transaction as to which notification has been made.
quote: (2) Reject any voluntary notice at any time, and so inform the parties promptly in writing, if, after the notice has been submitted and before action by the Committee or the President has been concluded: (i) There is a material change in the transaction as to which notification has been made;

statement: One listed ground for rejecting a voluntary notice before the conclusion of a review or investigation is that one of the parties submitting it has not submitted the final certification required by the notice-contents section.
quote: (5) Reject any voluntary notice before the conclusion of a review or investigation, and so inform the parties promptly in writing, if one of the parties submitting the voluntary notice has not submitted the final certification required by § 800.502(m);

statement: The Staff Chairperson may defer acceptance of a voluntary notice and the start of the review period to obtain information required under the section that has not been submitted by the notifying party or parties or other parties to the transaction.
quote: the Staff Chairperson may defer acceptance of the notice, and the beginning of the review period specified by § 800.503, to obtain any information required under this section that has not been submitted by the notifying party or parties or other parties to the transaction.

statement: Except as provided in paragraph (c) of the valuation section, the value of the transaction for the filing fee means the total value of all consideration; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0763.
quote: Except as provided in paragraph (c) of this section, the value of the transaction for purposes of determining the required fee amount in this subpart means the total value of all consideration

statement: The consideration counted is that which has been or will be provided in the context of the transaction by or on behalf of the foreign person that is a party, including cash, assets, shares or other ownership interests, debt forgiveness, or services or other in-kind consideration.
quote: that has been or will be provided in the context of the transaction by or on behalf of the foreign person that is a party to the transaction, including cash, assets, shares or other ownership interests, debt forgiveness, or services or other in-kind consideration.

statement: For consideration in securities traded on a national securities exchange, the value of the securities is the closing price on the national securities exchange on which the securities are primarily traded on the trading day immediately before the parties file the formal written notice; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0069.
quote: the value of the securities is the closing price on the national securities exchange on which the securities are primarily traded on the trading day immediately prior to the date the parties file the formal written notice

statement: Where the consideration is or includes other non-cash assets, services, interests or other in-kind consideration, its value is its fair market value as of the date the parties file the formal written notice.
quote: (2) Where the consideration is or includes other non-cash assets, services, interests, or other in-kind consideration, the value of the assets, services, interests, or other in-kind consideration is their fair market value as of the date the parties file the formal written notice.

statement: Where the transaction involves a merger or the contribution of one or more U.S. businesses to a joint venture, the value of the transaction is the fair market value of the U.S. businesses being merged or contributed.
quote: (2) Where the transaction involves a merger or the contribution of one or more U.S. businesses to a joint venture, the value of the transaction is the fair market value of the U.S. business(es) being merged or contributed.

statement: Fair market value means the price that would be received in exchange for sale of an interest, or paid to receive a service or to transfer liability, in an orderly transaction between market participants.
quote: Fair market value means the price that would be received in exchange for sale of an interest, or paid to receive a service or to transfer liability, in an orderly transaction between market participants.

statement: Where a transaction will be effectuated in multiple phases, the value of the transaction includes the total value of the multiple phases, as may be reasonably determined as of the date the parties file the formal written notice.
quote: (1) Where a transaction will be effectuated in multiple phases, the value of the transaction includes the total value of the multiple phases, as may be reasonably determined as of the date the parties file the formal written notice.

statement: Before rejecting a notice for an insufficient filing fee, the Staff Chairperson shall inform the parties in writing of the insufficiency of payment and provide the parties three business days to pay the remainder of the filing fee.
quote: Prior to rejecting a notice under § 800.504(a)(3), the Staff Chairperson shall inform the parties in writing of the insufficiency of payment and provide the parties three business days to pay the remainder of the filing fee.

statement: The Form 8-K filing rule for acquisition statements omitted from an initial registration statement covers a registrant other than a foreign private issuer required to file reports on Form 6-K or a shell company, other than a business combination related shell company.
quote: A registrant, other than a foreign private issuer required to file reports on Form 6-K (§ 249.306 of this chapter) or a shell company (other than a business combination related shell company), that omits from its initial registration statement

statement: Such a registrant must file those financial statements and any pro forma information under cover of Form 8-K no later than 75 days after consummation of the acquisition.
quote: must file those financial statements and any pro forma information specified by §§ 210.11-01 through 210.11-03 (Article 11) under cover of Form 8-K (§ 249.308 of this chapter) no later than 75 days after consummation of the acquisition

statement: The exception to omitting the pro forma effects of a business acquisition applies where the aggregate impact of businesses acquired or to be acquired is significant as determined by § 210.3-05(b)(2)(iv) or § 210.3-14(b)(2)(i)(C).
quote: except where the aggregate impact of businesses acquired or to be acquired is significant as determined by § 210.3-05(b)(2)(iv) or § 210.3-14(b)(2)(i)(C)

statement: The exception for retrospective revisions covers transactions required to be accounted for under U.S. GAAP or, as applicable, IFRS-IASB by retrospectively revising the historical statements of comprehensive income, such as a combination of entities under common control or discontinued operations.
quote: For transactions required to be accounted for under U.S. GAAP or, as applicable, IFRS-IASB by retrospectively revising the historical statements of comprehensive income (e.g., combination of entities under common control and discontinued operations)

statement: For those transactions, pro forma statements of comprehensive income must be filed for all periods for which historical financial statements of the registrant are required.
quote: pro forma statements of comprehensive income must be filed for all periods for which historical financial statements of the registrant are required.

statement: One condition for presenting Management's Adjustments is that there is a reasonable basis for each such adjustment.
quote: (i) Basis for Management's Adjustments. (A) There is a reasonable basis for each such adjustment.

statement: When synergies are presented, any related dis-synergies must also be presented.
quote: When synergies are presented, any related dis-synergies must also be presented.

statement: When the anticipated effective or mailing date falls within 45 days after the end of the fiscal year, the filing may include financial statements only as current as of the end of the third fiscal quarter.
quote: (a) When the anticipated effective or mailing date falls within 45 days after the end of the fiscal year, the filing may include financial statements only as current as of the end of the third fiscal quarter

statement: If the audited financial statements for the recently completed fiscal year are available or become available before effectiveness or mailing, they must be included in the filing.
quote: Provided, however, that if the audited financial statements for the recently completed fiscal year are available or become available before effectiveness or mailing, they must be included in the filing

statement: One condition for the smaller reporting company relief is that, if the company is a reporting company, all reports due must have been filed.
quote: (1) If the smaller reporting company is a reporting company, all reports due must have been filed

statement: One condition is that, for the most recent fiscal year for which audited financial statements are not yet available, the smaller reporting company reasonably and in good faith expects to report income from continuing operations attributable to the registrant before taxes.
quote: (2) For the most recent fiscal year for which audited financial statements are not yet available, the smaller reporting company reasonably and in good faith expects to report income from continuing operations attributable to the registrant before taxes

statement: One condition is that, for at least one of the two fiscal years immediately preceding the most recent fiscal year, the smaller reporting company reported income from continuing operations attributable to the registrant before taxes.
quote: (3) For at least one of the two fiscal years immediately preceding the most recent fiscal year the smaller reporting company reported income from continuing operations attributable to the registrant before taxes.

statement: The interim statement of cash flows may be abbreviated, starting with a single figure of net cash flows from operating activities; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0783.
quote: The statement of cash flows may be abbreviated starting with a single figure of net cash flows from operating activities

statement: Subject to the exception stated in the next sentence (CL-MNA-1525), in an abbreviated interim statement of cash flows, cash changes from investing and financing activities are shown individually only when they exceed 10% of the average of net cash flows from operating activities for the most recent three years.
quote: showing cash changes from investing and financing activities individually only when they exceed 10% of the average of net cash flows from operating activities for the most recent three years.

statement: A registrant engaged in seasonal production and sale of a single-crop agricultural commodity may provide interim statements of comprehensive income and cash flows for the twelve month period ended during the most recent fiscal quarter and for the corresponding preceding period; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0785.
quote: Registrants engaged in seasonal production and sale of a single-crop agricultural commodity may provide interim statements of comprehensive income and cash flows for the twelve month period ended during the most recent fiscal quarter and for the corresponding preceding period

statement: Those twelve month statements may be provided in lieu of the year-to-date statements specified in the Form 10-Q periods paragraphs for income and cash flows.
quote: in lieu of the year-to-date statements specified in paragraphs (c)(2) and (3) of this section

statement: The periods for which interim financial statements are to be provided in registration statements are prescribed elsewhere in Regulation S-X.
quote: The periods for which interim financial statements are to be provided in registration statements are prescribed elsewhere in this Regulation (see §§ 210.3-01 and 3-02)

statement: The accountant's report shall designate any auditing procedures deemed necessary by the accountant under the circumstances of the particular case which have been omitted, and the reasons for their omission.
quote: report: (1) Shall state the applicable professional standards under which the audit was conducted; and (2) Shall designate any auditing procedures deemed necessary by the accountant under the circumstances of the particular case, which have been omitted, and the reasons for their omission.

statement: Any matters to which the accountant takes exception shall be clearly identified, the exception specifically and clearly stated, and, to the extent practicable, the effect of each exception on the related financial statements given.
quote: (d) Exceptions identified in accountants' reports. Any matters to which the accountant takes exception shall be clearly identified, the exception thereto specifically and clearly stated, and, to the extent practicable, the effect of each such exception on the related financial statements given.

statement: The accountant's opinion may also be as to any changes in the accounting principles that have a material effect on the financial statements.
quote: (2) the opinion of the accountant as to the consistency of the application of the accounting principles, or as to any changes in such principles which have a material effect on the financial statements.

statement: The seven-year retention rule also applies after an accountant concludes an audit or review of the financial statements of any investment company registered under section 8 of the Investment Company Act of 1940; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0717.
quote: or of the financial statements of any investment company registered under section 8 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C. 80a-8), the accountant shall retain records

statement: Article 8 applies to financial statements filed for smaller reporting companies but not to financial statements prepared for the purposes of Item 17 or Item 18 of Form 20-F.
quote: Sections 210.8-01 through 210.8-08 (Article 8) shall be applicable to financial statements filed for smaller reporting companies. These sections are not applicable to financial statements prepared for the purposes of Item 17 or Item 18 of Form 20-F.

statement: In one listed example, a foreign person that receives the minority shareholder protections listed in the paragraph on protections but no other positive or negative rights with respect to the entity does not control it, assuming no other relevant facts.
quote: Corporation A receives minority shareholder protections listed in paragraph (c) of this section but receives no other positive or negative rights with respect to Corporation B. Assuming no other relevant facts, Corporation A does not control Corporation B.

statement: A joint venture of the listed kind is a covered control transaction only if one or more of the parties contributes a U.S. business and a foreign person could control that U.S. business by means of the joint venture.
quote: but only if one or more of the parties contributes a U.S. business and a foreign person could control that U.S. business by means of the joint venture.

statement: Transactions that are not covered control transactions include an acquisition of any part of an entity or of assets, if that part of an entity or those assets do not constitute a U.S. business.
quote: (c) An acquisition of any part of an entity or of assets, if such part of an entity or assets do not constitute a U.S. business.

statement: In the listed example of a covered investment by observer right, the foreign person is not an excepted investor and proposes to acquire a four percent, non-controlling equity interest in an entity in which it has no voting interests or any rights.
quote: Corporation A, a foreign person that is not an excepted investor, proposes to acquire a four percent, non-controlling equity interest in Corporation B, an entity in which Corporation A has no voting interests or any rights.

statement: No party to a transaction may file a voluntary notice if the transaction has been the subject of a declaration submitted under the declarations subpart and the Committee has not yet taken action on it under the section on Committee responses.
quote: (j) No party to a transaction may file a notice under paragraph (a) of this section if the transaction has been the subject of a declaration submitted under subpart D and the Committee has not yet taken action with respect to the transaction under § 800.407.

statement: In one listed example, a subsequent transaction may be a covered transaction because the direct acquirer in the initial transaction and the other foreign person are under common ownership of the same parent but the direct acquirer does not wholly own the other foreign person.
quote: The subsequent transaction may be a covered transaction because, while Corporation A and Corporation X are both under common ownership of Corporation Y, Corporation A (the direct acquirer in the initial transaction) does not wholly own Corporation X.

statement: Two of the listed conditions for the investment fund rule are that the foreign person does not have access to material nonpublic technical information as a result of its participation on the advisory board or committee and that the investment does not afford it any of the access, rights, or involvement specified in the covered investment definition.
quote: (5) The foreign person does not have access to material nonpublic technical information as a result of its participation on the advisory board or committee; and (6) The investment does not afford the foreign person any of the access, rights, or involvement specified in § 800.211(b).

statement: The significant possibility that must exist before the Committee accepts a notice or declaration on such a loan is that the foreign person may obtain control of a U.S. business, or acquire equity interest and access, rights, or involvement specified in the covered investment definition over a TID U.S. business, as a result of the default or other condition.
quote: there is a significant possibility that the foreign person may obtain control of a U.S. business, or acquire equity interest and access, rights, or involvement specified in § 800.211(b) over a TID U.S. business, as a result of the default or other condition.

statement: The control that the Committee may in extraordinary circumstances find in such a waiver is control of investment decisions of the investment fund or decisions relating to entities in which the investment fund is invested.
quote: to constitute control of investment decisions of the investment fund or decisions relating to entities in which the investment fund is invested.

statement: Follow-up information requested by the Staff Chairperson on a declaration may be due within a longer time frame if the party or parties so request in writing and the Staff Chairperson grants that request in writing.
quote: or within a longer time frame if the party (or parties) so request in writing and the Staff Chairperson grants that request in writing.

statement: A party or parties may not submit more than one declaration for the same or a substantially similar transaction without approval from the Staff Chairperson.
quote: (e) A party (or parties) may not submit more than one declaration for the same or a substantially similar transaction without approval from the Staff Chairperson.

statement: One listed ground for rejecting a voluntary notice at any time after it has been accepted is that the submitting party or parties do not provide follow-up information requested by the Staff Chairperson within three business days of the request; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0807.
quote: Reject any voluntary notice at any time after the notice has been accepted, and so inform the parties promptly in writing, if the party or parties that have submitted the voluntary notice do not provide follow-up information requested by the Staff Chairperson within three business days

statement: Follow-up information requested after a voluntary notice has been accepted may be due within a longer time frame if the parties so request in writing and the Staff Chairperson grants that request in writing.
quote: or within a longer time frame if the parties so request in writing and the Staff Chairperson grants that request in writing

statement: Where the value of a transaction is $5,000,000 or more but it includes one or more non-U.S. businesses and the value of the interest acquired in the U.S. business is less than $5,000,000, the filing fee under the section on the amount of the fee is applicable.
quote: (3) Where the value of a transaction is $5,000,000 or more, but the transaction includes one or more non-U.S. businesses, and the value of the interest acquired in the U.S. business is less than $5,000,000, the filing fee under § 800.1101(b) is applicable.

statement: For an interest for which consideration has not been determined, the value of the transaction includes the fair market value of the interest being acquired in the transaction as of the date the parties file the formal written notice.
quote: the value of the transaction includes, with respect to the interest for which consideration has not been determined, the fair market value of the interest being acquired in the transaction as of the date the parties file the formal written notice.

statement: A foreign person is any foreign national, foreign government or foreign entity, or any entity over which a foreign national, foreign government or foreign entity exercises or can exercise control.
quote: The term foreign person means: (1) Any foreign national, foreign government, or foreign entity; or (2) Any entity over which control is exercised or exercisable by a foreign national, foreign government, or foreign entity.

statement: An entity over which a foreign person exercises or can exercise control is itself a foreign person.
quote: (b) Any entity over which control is exercised or exercisable by a foreign person is a foreign person.

statement: A person who directly or indirectly holds or will hold at least 50 percent of the outstanding voting interest in an entity is a parent of that entity.
quote: (a) The term parent means, with respect to an entity: (1) A person who or which directly or indirectly: (i) Holds or will hold at least 50 percent of the outstanding voting interest in the entity;

statement: One listed way to be a parent of an entity is to hold, or have the right to, at least 50 percent of its profits or at least 50 percent of its assets on dissolution, and another listed way is to be its general partner, managing member or equivalent.
quote: (ii) Holds or will hold the right to at least 50 percent of the profits of the entity, or has or will have the right in the event of dissolution to at least 50 percent of the assets of the entity; or (2) The general partner, managing member, or equivalent of the entity.

statement: An entity that meets a parent condition with respect to an intermediate parent is also a parent of any other entity of which the intermediate parent is a parent.
quote: (b) Any entity that meets the conditions of paragraph (a)(1) or (2) of this section with respect to another entity (i.e., the intermediate parent) is also a parent of any other entity of which the intermediate parent is a parent.

statement: A U.S. business is any entity engaged in interstate commerce in the United States, irrespective of the nationality of the persons that control it.
quote: (a) The term U.S. business means any entity, irrespective of the nationality of the persons that control it, engaged in interstate commerce in the United States.

statement: In the case of an acquisition of an ownership interest in an entity, the parties to the transaction include the person acquiring the interest, the person from whom it is acquired and the entity whose interest is being acquired; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0817 and CL-MNA-0818.
quote: (a) The term party to a transaction means: (1) In the case of an acquisition of an ownership interest in an entity, the person acquiring the ownership interest, the person from whom such ownership interest is acquired, and the entity whose ownership interest is being acquired

statement: In the case of an acquisition of an ownership interest in an entity, the listed parties are determined without regard to any person providing brokerage or underwriting services for the transaction.
quote: the entity whose ownership interest is being acquired, without regard to any person providing brokerage or underwriting services for the transaction

statement: One listed party rule makes the surviving entity and the entities merged with or into it the parties in a merger, and another makes the entities being consolidated and the new consolidated entity the parties in a consolidation.
quote: (2) In the case of a merger, the surviving entity, and the entity or entities that are merged with or into that entity in the transaction; (3) In the case of a consolidation, the entities being consolidated, and the new consolidated entity;

statement: For the statute's mitigation provision, the term party to a transaction includes any affiliate of a listed party that the Committee, or a lead agency acting on its behalf, determines is relevant to mitigating a risk to national security.
quote: (b) For purposes of section 721(l), the term party to a transaction includes any affiliate of any party described in paragraph (a) of this section that the Committee, or a lead agency acting on behalf of the Committee, determines is relevant to mitigating a risk to the national security

statement: A transaction, whether proposed or completed, includes a merger, acquisition or takeover, including the acquisition of an ownership interest in an entity and the acquisition of proxies from holders of a voting interest in an entity.
quote: The term transaction means any of the following, whether proposed or completed: (a) A merger, acquisition, or takeover, including: (1) The acquisition of an ownership interest in an entity; (2) The acquisition of proxies from holders of a voting interest in an entity;

statement: Further listed forms of merger, acquisition or takeover are a merger or consolidation, the formation of a joint venture, and a long-term lease or concession arrangement under which the lessee makes substantially all business decisions concerning the operation of the leased entity as if it were the owner.
quote: (3) A merger or consolidation; (4) The formation of a joint venture; or (5) A long-term lease or concession arrangement under which a lessee (or equivalent) makes substantially all business decisions concerning the operation of a leased entity (or equivalent), as if it were the owner;

statement: Except as provided in the listed exceptions and otherwise in the part, the regulations in the part apply from February 13, 2020.
quote: (a) Except as provided in paragraphs (b) through (f) of this section and otherwise in this part, the regulations in this part apply from February 13, 2020.

statement: Subject to paragraph (c) of that section, for a transaction for which a listed event, one being the completion date, occurred before February 13, 2020, the provisions of the regulations in effect on February 12, 2020 apply.
quote: (b) Subject to paragraph (c) of this section, for any transaction for which the following has occurred before February 13, 2020, the corresponding provisions of the regulations in this part that were in effect on February 12, 2020, will apply: (1) The completion date;

statement: Except as the earlier transitional paragraphs provide, the amendments to the part published in the Federal Register on September 15, 2020 apply from October 15, 2020.
quote: (e) Except as provided in paragraphs (b) through (d) of this section, the amendments to this part published in the Federal Register on September 15, 2020 apply from October 15, 2020.

statement: Notwithstanding the earlier transitional paragraphs, the amendments to the part published in the Federal Register on November 26, 2024 apply from December 26, 2024.
quote: (f) Notwithstanding paragraphs (b) through (d) of this section, the amendments to this part published in the Federal Register on November 26, 2024 apply from December 26, 2024.

statement: One part of the definition of sensitive personal data, which is subject to the exclusions paragraph, concerns identifiable data that is maintained or collected by a U.S. business that meets one of the listed conditions.
quote: (a) The term sensitive personal data means, except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section: (1) Identifiable data that is: (i) Maintained or collected by a U.S. business that:

statement: One listed business test is that the U.S. business targets or tailors products or services to any U.S. executive branch agency or military department with intelligence, national security or homeland security responsibilities, or to their personnel and contractors.
quote: (A) Targets or tailors products or services to any U.S. executive branch agency or military department with intelligence, national security, or homeland security responsibilities, or to personnel and contractors thereof;

statement: One listed business test is that the U.S. business has maintained or collected identifiable data within the listed categories on greater than one million individuals at any point over the twelve months preceding the earliest of a set of dates that begins with the completion date; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0917, CL-MNA-0829 and CL-MNA-0918.
quote: (B) Has maintained or collected any identifiable data within one or more categories described in paragraph (a)(1)(ii) of this section on greater than one million individuals at any point over the twelve (12) months preceding the earliest of the completion date,

statement: The population test does not apply if the U.S. business can demonstrate that at the time of the completion date of the transaction it had or will have neither the capability to maintain nor the capability to collect the data the test covers; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0918.
quote: unless the U.S. business can demonstrate that at the time of the completion date of the transaction it had or will have neither the capability to maintain nor the capability to collect any identifiable data

statement: One listed business test is that the U.S. business has a demonstrated business objective to maintain or collect identifiable data within the listed categories on greater than one million individuals and such data is an integrated part of its primary products or services.
quote: (C) Has a demonstrated business objective to maintain or collect any identifiable data within one or more categories described in paragraph (a)(1)(ii) of this section on greater than one million individuals and such data is an integrated part of the U.S. business's primary products or services;

statement: The identifiable data must also be within one of the listed categories, the first of which is financial data that could be used to analyze or determine an individual's financial distress or hardship.
quote: and (ii) Within any of the following categories: (A) Financial data that could be used to analyze or determine an individual's financial distress or hardship;

statement: Two further listed categories are the set of data in an application for health insurance, long-term care insurance, professional liability insurance, mortgage insurance or life insurance, and data relating to the physical, mental or psychological health condition of an individual.
quote: (C) The set of data in an application for health insurance, long-term care insurance, professional liability insurance, mortgage insurance, or life insurance; (D) Data relating to the physical, mental, or psychological health condition of an individual;

statement: Subject to the exclusions paragraph, the results of an individual's genetic tests, including any related genetic sequencing data, are covered whenever the results constitute identifiable data, but not data derived from databases maintained by the federal government and routinely provided to private parties for purposes of research.
quote: genetic tests, including any related genetic sequencing data, whenever such results constitute identifiable data. Such results shall not include data derived from databases maintained by the U.S. Government and routinely provided to private parties for purposes of research.

statement: The term sensitive personal data does not include the data in the listed exclusions, regardless of whether the criteria in the definition apply.
quote: (b) The term sensitive personal data shall not include, regardless of the applicability of the criteria described in paragraph (a) of this section:

statement: Two listed exclusions are data a U.S. business maintains or collects concerning its own employees, unless the data pertains to employees of government contractors who hold government personnel security clearances, and data that is a matter of public record.
quote: (1) Data maintained or collected by a U.S. business concerning the employees of that U.S. business, unless the data pertains to employees of U.S. Government contractors who hold U.S. Government personnel security clearances; or (2) Data that is a matter of public record

statement: Material nonpublic technical information is information that provides knowledge, know-how or understanding, in each case not available in the public domain, of the design, location or operation of covered investment critical infrastructure; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0837.
quote: (a) The term material nonpublic technical information means information that: (1) Provides knowledge, know-how, or understanding, in each case not available in the public domain, of the design, location, or operation of covered investment critical infrastructure,

statement: A second listed kind of material nonpublic technical information is information that is not available in the public domain and is necessary to design, fabricate, develop, test, produce or manufacture a critical technology, including processes, techniques or methods.
quote: (2) Is not available in the public domain and is necessary to design, fabricate, develop, test, produce, or manufacture a critical technology, including processes, techniques, or methods.

statement: The term material nonpublic technical information does not include financial information regarding the performance of an entity.
quote: (b) The term material nonpublic technical information does not include financial information regarding the performance of an entity.

statement: Substantive decisionmaking is the process through which decisions regarding significant matters affecting an entity are undertaken, including, as applicable, pricing, sales and specific contracts, including the license, sale or transfer of sensitive personal data to any third party.
quote: The term substantive decisionmaking means the process through which decisions regarding significant matters affecting an entity are undertaken, including, as applicable: (1) Pricing, sales, and specific contracts, including the license, sale, or transfer of sensitive personal data to any third party

statement: The term substantive decisionmaking does not include strictly administrative decisions.
quote: (b) The term substantive decisionmaking does not include strictly administrative decisions.

statement: Targets or tailors means customizing products or services for use by a person or group of persons or actively marketing to or soliciting a person or group of persons.
quote: (a) The term targets or tailors means customizing products or services for use by a person or group of persons or actively marketing to or soliciting a person or group of persons.

statement: If the parties to a transaction file a voluntary notice, they shall provide in detail the information the section sets out, which must be accurate and complete with respect to all parties and to the transaction.
quote: (a) If the parties to a transaction file a voluntary notice, they shall provide in detail the information set out in this section, which must be accurate and complete with respect to all parties and to the transaction.

statement: A voluntary notice shall describe or provide, as applicable, the listed information, the first item being a summary setting forth the essentials of the transaction, including a statement of its purpose.
quote: (c) A voluntary notice filed under § 800.501 shall describe or provide, as applicable: (1) The following information regarding the transaction in question: (i) A summary setting forth the essentials of the transaction, including a statement of the purpose of the transaction

statement: One listed item is the value of the transaction in U.S. dollars as determined under the valuation section and the parties' assessment of the applicable fee, including an explanation of the methodology used to determine the valuation and fee.
quote: (viii) (A) The value of the transaction in U.S. dollars, as determined under § 800.1103, and the parties' assessment of the applicable fee due under § 800.1101, including an explanation of the methodology used to determine such valuation and applicable fee;

statement: Two listed items are the name of every financial institution involved in the transaction, including as advisors, underwriters or sources of financing, and a copy of any partnership agreements, integration agreements or other side agreements relating to the transaction.
quote: (ix) The name of any and all financial institutions involved in the transaction, including as advisors, underwriters, or sources of financing for the transaction; (x) A copy of any partnership agreements, integration agreements, or other side agreements relating to the transaction;

statement: One listed item, within the group that concerns the target U.S. business and the entities it is a parent of, is each other contract, identified by agency and number, that is currently in effect or was in effect within the past three years with a federal agency or component with national defense, homeland security or other national security responsibilities; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0084.
quote: (iv) Any other contract (identified by agency and number) that is currently in effect or was in effect within the past three years with any U.S. Government agency or component with national defense, homeland security, or other national security responsibilities

statement: A certification is a written statement signed by the chief executive officer or other duly authorized designee of a party filing a notice, declaration or information, certifying under the penalties of the False Statements Accountability Act of 1996; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0927 and CL-MNA-0085.
quote: (a) The term certification means a written statement signed by the chief executive officer or other duly authorized designee of a party filing a notice, declaration, or information, certifying under the penalties provided in the False Statements Accountability Act of 1996

statement: Two listed cases of a duly authorized designee are, for a partnership, any general partner and, for a corporation, any officer or director.
quote: (b) For purposes of this section, a duly authorized designee is: (1) In the case of a partnership, any general partner thereof; (2) In the case of a corporation, any officer or director thereof;

statement: In each listed case, the designee must possess actual authority to make the certification on behalf of the party filing a notice, declaration or information.
quote: (c) In each case described in paragraphs (b)(1) through (4) of this section, such designee must possess actual authority to make the certification on behalf of the party filing a notice, declaration, or information.

statement: A party submitting a declaration under section 800.401 or section 800.402 shall submit electronically the information set out in section 800.404, including the certifications required under it, to the Staff Chairperson.
quote: (a) A party or parties submitting a declaration of a transaction under § 800.401 or § 800.402 shall submit electronically the information set out in § 800.404, including the certifications required thereunder, to the Staff Chairperson

statement: A party to a transaction that has filed notice under section 800.501(a) may request in writing, at any time prior to conclusion of all action under the statute, that the notice be withdrawn.
quote: (a) A party (or parties) to a transaction that has filed notice under § 800.501(a) may request in writing, at any time prior to conclusion of all action under section 721, that such notice be withdrawn.

statement: A request to withdraw a notice shall be directed to the Staff Chairperson and state the reasons for the request, and such requests will ordinarily be granted unless otherwise determined by the Committee.
quote: Such request shall be directed to the Staff Chairperson and shall state the reasons why the request is being made. Such requests will ordinarily be granted, unless otherwise determined by the Committee.

statement: In deciding whether to include the rights a holder of a contingent equity interest will acquire on conversion in its covered transaction analysis, the Committee will consider factors that include the imminence of conversion or satisfaction of contingent conditions.
quote: in the Committee's analysis of whether a notified transaction is a covered transaction, the Committee will consider factors that include: (1) The imminence of conversion or satisfaction of contingent conditions;

statement: Paragraph (b) operates when the Committee, applying paragraph (a), determines that the rights a holder will acquire on conversion or satisfaction of a contingent condition will not be included in its analysis of whether a notified or submitted transaction is a covered transaction; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0855.
quote: (b) When the Committee, applying paragraph (a) of this section, determines that the rights that the holder will acquire upon conversion or satisfaction of contingent condition will not be included in the Committee's analysis of whether a notified or submitted transaction is a covered transaction,

statement: Under paragraph (b), the Committee will disregard the contingent equity interest for purposes of that transaction except to the extent that the interest conveys immediate rights to the holder with respect to the entity that issued it.
quote: the Committee will disregard the contingent equity interest for purposes of that transaction except to the extent that they convey immediate rights to the holder with respect to the entity that issued the interest.

statement: Parties to a transaction that is notified or declared shall provide information to the Staff Chairperson that will enable the Committee to conduct a full assessment, review, or investigation of the transaction.
quote: (1) Parties to a transaction that is notified or declared under subpart D or E of this part shall provide information to the Staff Chairperson that will enable the Committee to conduct a full assessment, review, and/or investigation of the transaction.

statement: Except as provided in the disclosure exceptions, information or documentary material filed with the Committee under the part, including material filed under a listed notice paragraph, is exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act.
quote: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, any information or documentary material submitted or filed with the Committee under this part, including information or documentary material filed under § 800.501(g), shall be exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act

statement: The confidentiality paragraph does not prohibit disclosure of information relevant to any administrative or judicial action or proceeding, or of information to Congress or to any duly authorized committee or subcommittee of Congress.
quote: (b) Paragraph (a) of this section shall not prohibit disclosure of the following: (1) Information relevant to any administrative or judicial action or proceeding; (2) Information to Congress or to any duly authorized committee or subcommittee of Congress;

statement: The Defense Production Act provisions relating to fines and imprisonment apply with respect to the disclosure of information or documentary material filed with the Committee under the regulations.
quote: (e) The provisions of the Defense Production Act Reauthorization of 2003, as amended (50 U.S.C. 4555(d)) relating to fines and imprisonment shall apply with respect to the disclosure of information or documentary material filed with the Committee under these regulations.

statement: Part 210, together with the Financial Reporting Releases, sets out the form, content and requirements for financial statements that are required to be filed as part of the filings listed in that paragraph.
quote: (a) This part (together with the Financial Reporting Releases (part 211 of this chapter)) sets forth the form and content of and requirements for financial statements required to be filed as a part of:

statement: One listed filing is a registration statement under the Securities Act of 1933, except as otherwise specifically provided in the forms used for registration under that Act.
quote: (1) Registration statements under the Securities Act of 1933 (part 239 of this chapter), except as otherwise specifically provided in the forms which are to be used for registration under this Act

statement: An affiliate of, or a person affiliated with, a specific person is a person that directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with the person specified.
quote: (b) Affiliate. An affiliate of, or a person affiliated with, a specific person is a person that directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with, the person specified.

statement: The term control, including the terms controlling, controlled by and under common control with, means the possession, direct or indirect, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of a person, whether through the ownership of voting shares, by contract, or otherwise.
quote: control (including the terms controlling, controlled by and under common control with) means the possession, direct or indirect, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of a person, whether through the ownership of voting shares, by contract, or otherwise.

statement: A majority-owned subsidiary is a subsidiary more than 50 percent of whose outstanding voting shares is owned by its parent and/or the parent's other majority-owned subsidiaries.
quote: (n) Majority-owned subsidiary. The term majority-owned subsidiary means a subsidiary more than 50 percent of whose outstanding voting shares is owned by its parent and/or the parent's other majority-owned subsidiaries.

statement: The general paragraph defines a significant subsidiary as a subsidiary, including its subsidiaries, that meets any of the conditions in the investment, asset or income test paragraphs, subject to an exception stated immediately after; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0866.
quote: (1) The term significant subsidiary means a subsidiary, including its subsidiaries, which meets any of the conditions in paragraph (w)(1)(i), (ii), or (iii) of this section; however

statement: If the registrant is a registered investment company or a business development company, the tested subsidiary meets any of the conditions in paragraph (w)(2) instead of any of the conditions in paragraph (w)(1).
quote: however if the registrant is a registered investment company or a business development company, the tested subsidiary meets any of the conditions in paragraph (w)(2) of this section instead of any of the conditions in this paragraph (w)(1).

statement: One investment-test paragraph applies to acquisitions other than those described in paragraph (w)(1)(i)(B), and to dispositions; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0868 and CL-MNA-0869.
quote: (A) For acquisitions, other than those described in paragraph (w)(1)(i)(B) of this section, and dispositions this test is met when

statement: One investment-test comparison is met when the registrant's and its other subsidiaries' investments in and advances to the tested subsidiary exceed 10 percent of the aggregate worldwide market value of the registrant's voting and non-voting common equity; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0869.
quote: this test is met when the registrant's and its other subsidiaries' investments in and advances to the tested subsidiary exceed 10 percent of the aggregate worldwide market value of the registrant's voting and non-voting common equity,

statement: If the registrant has no such aggregate worldwide market value, the first investment-test comparison is made instead against the total assets of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.
quote: or if the registrant has no such aggregate worldwide market value the total assets of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.

statement: In all other cases, the investment test is met when the registrant's and its other subsidiaries' investments in and advances to the tested subsidiary exceed 10 percent of the total assets of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.
quote: (C) In all other cases, this test is met when the registrant's and its other subsidiaries' investments in and advances to the tested subsidiary exceed 10 percent of the total assets of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.

statement: The asset test is met when the registrant's and its other subsidiaries' proportionate share of the tested subsidiary's consolidated total assets, after intercompany eliminations, exceeds 10 percent of such total assets of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0940.
quote: (ii) Asset test. This test is met when the registrant's and its other subsidiaries' proportionate share of the tested subsidiary's consolidated total assets (after intercompany eliminations) exceeds 10 percent of such total assets of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated
note: The measurement date for the comparison is stated in CL-MNA-0940.

statement: The revenue comparison in the income test is that the registrant's and its other subsidiaries' proportionate share of the tested subsidiary's consolidated total revenue from continuing operations, after intercompany eliminations, exceeds 10 percent of such total revenue of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0960.
quote: The registrant's and its other subsidiaries' proportionate share of the tested subsidiary's consolidated total revenue from continuing operations (after intercompany eliminations) exceeds 10 percent of such total revenue of the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated
note: This is the revenue component; the income or loss component is in CL-MNA-0936 and CL-MNA-0937, and the revenue component's exception is in the next claim.

statement: The revenue component of the income test does not apply if either the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated or the tested subsidiary did not have material revenue in each of the two most recently completed fiscal years.
quote: This paragraph (w)(1)(iii)(A)(2) does not apply if either the registrant and its subsidiaries consolidated or the tested subsidiary did not have material revenue in each of the two most recently completed fiscal years.

statement: The Commission will not recognize an accountant as independent, with respect to an audit client, if the accountant is not, or a reasonable investor with knowledge of all relevant facts and circumstances would conclude that the accountant is not, capable of exercising objective and impartial judgment; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0935.
quote: The Commission will not recognize an accountant as independent, with respect to an audit client, if the accountant is not, or a reasonable investor with knowledge of all relevant facts and circumstances would conclude that the accountant is not, capable of exercising objective and impartial judgment
note: The rest of the sentence, quoted in CL-MNA-0935, says the judgment is judgment on all issues encompassed within the accountant's engagement.

statement: In determining whether an accountant is independent, the Commission will consider all relevant circumstances, including all relationships between the accountant and the audit client, and not just those relating to reports filed with the Commission.
quote: In determining whether an accountant is independent, the Commission will consider all relevant circumstances, including all relationships between the accountant and the audit client, and not just those relating to reports filed with the Commission.

statement: The rule sets out restrictions on financial, employment and business relationships between an accountant and an audit client, and restrictions on an accountant providing certain non-audit services to an audit client.
quote: Accordingly, the rule sets forth restrictions on financial, employment, and business relationships between an accountant and an audit client and restrictions on an accountant providing certain non-audit services to an audit client.

statement: The paragraph on specific circumstances sets out a non-exclusive specification of circumstances inconsistent with the general standard.
quote: (c) This paragraph sets forth a non-exclusive specification of circumstances inconsistent with paragraph (b) of this section.

statement: An accountant is not independent if, at any point during the audit and professional engagement period, the accountant has a direct financial interest or a material indirect financial interest in the accountant's audit client.
quote: (1) Financial relationships. An accountant is not independent if, at any point during the audit and professional engagement period, the accountant has a direct financial interest or a material indirect financial interest in the accountant's audit client, such as:

statement: An accountant is not independent when the accounting firm, any covered person in the firm, or any of his or her immediate family members has any direct investment in an audit client, such as stocks, bonds, notes, options, or other securities; the text continues in CL-MNA-1527, CL-MNA-1528 and CL-MNA-1529.
quote: (i) Investments in audit clients. An accountant is not independent when: (A) The accounting firm, any covered person in the firm, or any of his or her immediate family members, has any direct investment in an audit client, such as stocks, bonds, notes, options, or other securities.

statement: An accountant is not independent if, at any point during the audit and professional engagement period, the accountant has an employment relationship with an audit client.
quote: (2) Employment relationships. An accountant is not independent if, at any point during the audit and professional engagement period, the accountant has an employment relationship with an audit client, such as:

statement: One listed employment relationship is that a current partner, principal, shareholder, or professional employee of the accounting firm is employed by the audit client or serves as a member of the board of directors or similar management or governing body of the audit client.
quote: (i) Employment at audit client of accountant. A current partner, principal, shareholder, or professional employee of the accounting firm is employed by the audit client or serves as a member of the board of directors or similar management or governing body of the audit client.

statement: Notwithstanding the paragraphs on investments and other financial interests, an accountant will not be deemed not independent in the cases listed under the exceptions paragraph.
quote: (iii) Exceptions. Notwithstanding paragraphs (c)(1)(i) and (c)(1)(ii) of this section, an accountant will not be deemed not independent if:

statement: The rule is aimed at each registered public accounting firm that performs for an audit client that is an issuer, as defined in section 10A(f) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, other than an issuer that is an Asset-Backed Issuer as defined in the section cited; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0884, CL-MNA-0885, CL-MNA-0886 and CL-MNA-0887.
quote: Each registered public accounting firm that performs for an audit client that is an issuer (as defined in section 10A(f) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78j-1(f))), other than an issuer that is an Asset-Backed Issuer as defined in § 229.1101 of this chapter

statement: The rule also reaches an audit client that is an investment company registered under section 8 of the Investment Company Act of 1940, other than a unit investment trust as defined by section 4(2) of that Act; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0885, CL-MNA-0886 and CL-MNA-0887.
quote: or an investment company registered under section 8 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C. 80a-8), other than a unit investment trust as defined by section 4(2) of the Investment Company Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C. 80a-4(2)),

statement: For any audit required under the securities laws, the covered firm shall report prior to the filing of the audit report with the Commission; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0886 and CL-MNA-0887.
quote: any audit required under the securities laws shall report, prior to the filing of such audit report with the Commission
note: The sentence has a parenthetical, quoted in CL-MNA-0886, that sets different timing for a registered investment company.

statement: In the case of a registered investment company, the report is made annually, and if the annual communication is not within 90 days prior to the filing, an update of any changes to the previously reported information is provided in the 90 day period prior to the filing.
quote: (or in the case of a registered investment company, annually, and if the annual communication is not within 90 days prior to the filing, provide an update, in the 90 day period prior to the filing, of any changes to the previously reported information)

statement: The firm reports to the audit committee of the issuer or registered investment company, and the first listed matter is all critical accounting policies and practices to be used.
quote: to the audit committee of the issuer or registered investment company: (1) All critical accounting policies and practices to be used;

statement: One listed matter is all alternative treatments within Generally Accepted Accounting Principles for policies and practices related to material items that have been discussed with management of the issuer or registered investment company.
quote: (2) All alternative treatments within Generally Accepted Accounting Principles for policies and practices related to material items that have been discussed with management of the issuer or registered investment company, including:

statement: If a period or periods reported on include operations of a business prior to the date of acquisition, or for other reasons differ from reports previously issued for any period, the statements shall be reconciled as to sales or revenues and net income; the quoted sentence is incomplete here and continues in CL-MNA-0890.
